# NYC-Tron UI, full documentation

> Every documentation page in one file (565 pages, ref main). This file is large. For one component, fetch its page: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/docs/components/<id>.md. The short index is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/NYC-Tron-UI/main/llms.txt.

## Theme contract

Components ship no colours. The app defines these variables for light and dark. A missing variable does not fail the build; the utility silently produces no style.

| Token | CSS variable | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| color.primary | --color-primary | #1f5fd1 | #7aa7ff |
| color.onPrimary | --color-on-primary | #ffffff | #0b1730 |
| color.surfaceRaised | --color-surface-raised | #ffffff | #1b1f26 |
| color.surfaceSunken | --color-surface-sunken | #f1f3f6 | #12151a |
| color.border | --color-border | #c9ced6 | #39404b |
| color.text | --color-text | #15181d | #e8ebf0 |
| color.textMuted | --color-text-muted | #5a626e | #a3abb7 |
| color.danger | --color-danger | #b42318 | #ff8a80 |
| color.onDanger | --color-on-danger | #ffffff | #2b0703 |
| color.accent | --color-accent | #1f7a6d | #5fd0bf |
| color.info | --color-info | #1d5fa8 | #8ab8ff |
| color.success | --color-success | #1e7a3c | #6fd08c |
| color.focus | --color-focus | #1f5fd1 | #7aa7ff |
| radius.control | --radius-control | 8px (InFraX preset 4px) | same |
| radius.card | --radius-card | 12px (InFraX preset 6px) | same |

Reference values are neutral, not a brand. The required variables are primary, onPrimary, surfaceRaised, surfaceSunken, border, text, textMuted and focus. danger, onDanger, accent, info and success are optional.

# Button

## Purpose

Pressable text button with primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants, loading spinner and icon slot, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/Button
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { Button } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Button";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { Button } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/Button";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts` (same package).
- react-native (peer, required): Pressable, Text, View, ActivityIndicator.
- react (peer, required, types only).
- No optional peers.

## Props

Extends `Omit<PressableProps,"children"|"disabled">`. Read or overridden from the inherited set: `onPress` (passed through), `style` (a function or value, merged after the built-in min sizes), `hitSlop` (defaults to 2 when `size` is `sm`), `accessibilityLabel` (defaults to `title`), `accessibilityState` (merged, `disabled` and `busy` overwritten). `disabled` is redeclared as a plain boolean.

Extends: `Omit<PressableProps, "children" | "disabled">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `Ref<ComponentRef<typeof Pressable>>` | none | no | React 19 ref-as-prop, reaches the Pressable. |
| `title` | `string` | none | yes | Label text and default accessibilityLabel. |
| `targetSize` | `number` | none | no | Throws RangeError unless finite and at least 44. Sets minWidth and minHeight, and drops `min-h-*` from the size class. |
| `numberOfLines` | `number` | none | no | Throws RangeError unless an integer from 1 to 64. Forwarded to the label Text. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Rendered in a View before the label. |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `"primary"` | no |  |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | `"md"` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Combined with `loading` into one disabled flag. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Shows an ActivityIndicator and disables the control. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no | Appended last. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Drops every default visual class; layout classes `flex-row items-center justify-center` stay. |
| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `iconClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.primary`: `bg-primary` x1
- `color.border`: `border-border` x2
- `color.onPrimary`: `text-on-primary` x2
- `color.surfaceRaised`: `bg-surface-raised` x1
- `color.text`: `text-text` x2
- `color.danger`: `bg-danger border-danger` x2
- `color.onDanger`: `text-on-danger` x1
- `color.focus`: `ring-focus` x1
- `radius.control`: `rounded-control` x1
- Inline literals `minWidth: 44`, `minHeight` 40/44/48, `hitSlop` 2, `flexShrink: 1`: no token (tokenuse reports none for this file).

Tailwind default classes (no token): `border` x7, `min-h-10`, `min-h-11`, `min-h-12`, `gap-2` x2, `gap-3`, `px-3`, `px-4`, `px-5`, `py-2` x2, `py-3`, `opacity-80`, `opacity-50`, `font-semibold`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Whether the `className` prop is applied to the Pressable depends on the host's className interop (it is spread through an untyped object); the source shows no fallback.

## Variants

### variant

| Value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `primary` | root `bg-primary border-border text-on-primary`, label `text-on-primary`. |
| `secondary` | root `bg-surface-raised border-border`, label `text-text`. |
| `ghost` | root `bg-transparent border-transparent`, label `text-text`. |
| `danger` | root `bg-danger border-danger`, label `text-on-danger`. |

### size

| Value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `sm` | `min-h-10 gap-2 px-3 py-2`, minHeight 40. |
| `md` | `min-h-11 gap-2 px-4 py-2.5`, minHeight 44. |
| `lg` | `min-h-12 gap-3 px-5 py-3`, minHeight 48. |

minWidth is 44 for every size.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | derived in code | classes above. |
| `pressed` | class `active:opacity-80` | `active:opacity-80` class (styled only). The `style` prop also receives the Pressable state. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` (styled only). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | `disabled` prop; sets Pressable `disabled`, `accessibilityState.disabled`, and `opacity-50`. |
| `loading` | `loading` prop | `loading` prop; renders `ActivityIndicator` with accessibilityLabel "Loading", sets `accessibilityState.busy`, disables the control, applies `opacity-50`. |
| `hover` | derived in code | no code. |

### Motion

`active:opacity-80` and `motion-reduce:transition-none` classes. No Animated or Reanimated calls, no durations.

### Platform notes

none in source. The package.json export entry has `types`, `react-native` and `default` conditions only.

## A11y

- Contrast: Label pairs: primary onPrimary/primary 5.81/7.46:1; danger onDanger/danger 6.57/8.11:1; secondary and ghost text/surfaceRaised 17.79/13.83:1. Loading spinner has no color prop (Button.tsx:68): iOS default #999999 on primary is 2.04/1.19:1 (F11). Disabled and loading use opacity 0.5, exempt as an inactive control.
- Keyboard and focus: Web: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) at Button.tsx:55. Keyboard: native Pressable. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: minWidth 44 and minHeight 40/44/48 by size (Button.tsx:59, size.touch for 44, 40 and 48 have no token); sm adds hitSlop 2 (:61) so its hit area is 44. targetSize prop throws below 44. iOS pass. Android: sm and md 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: accessibilityRole=button, accessibilityLabel defaults to title, accessibilityState disabled and busy (:63-65). Spinner labelled Loading. Nothing missing.
- Motion: No animation besides the platform ActivityIndicator. `motion-reduce:transition-none` (:55) has no transition class beside it, so it does nothing as written (F09).
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Spinner colour on primary and danger fills is 2.04/1.19:1 on iOS if the platform default applies.
  - UNVERIFIED: Loading spinner contrast on the primary and danger fills (F11). Test: Render loading Button on an iOS simulator, sample the spinner pixel against the fill, or set color explicitly and re-measure.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=Button
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { Button } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Button";

export function SaveRow({ saving, onSave }: { saving: boolean; onSave: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Button
      title="Save changes"
      variant="primary"
      size="md"
      loading={saving}
      icon={<Text>+</Text>}
      numberOfLines={1}
      onPress={onSave}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `loading` while a save runs, since it shows the ActivityIndicator, sets `accessibilityState.busy` and disables the control in one prop.
- Pass `targetSize` of 44 or more when a design needs a larger hit area, because it sets both `minWidth` and `minHeight`.
- Give `numberOfLines` an integer from 1 to 64 to cap long labels, because the value is forwarded to the label Text.

### Don't

- Do not pass `targetSize` below 44 or a non-finite value, because it throws a RangeError at render.
- Do not rely on the loading spinner against `primary` or `danger` fills; its iOS default color measures 2.04:1 and 1.19:1 (F11) and is UNVERIFIED.
- Do not assume `className` reaches the Pressable on every host; the page marks that UNVERIFIED because it depends on the host's className interop.

# Card

## Purpose

Static container View with raised, sunken or transparent surface and optional padding, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/Card
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { Card } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Card";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { Card } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/Card";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

Extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. `style` is passed through unchanged.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| `surface` | `CardSurface` | `"raised"` | no |  |
| `padded` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Adds `p-4` when styled. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no | Appended last. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Removes all default classes. |

### Tokens

- `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.border` x2, `color.surfaceSunken` x1 (surface classes)
- `radius.card`: `rounded-card` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `border` x6, `p-4`.

### Unverified

none

## Variants

### surface

| Value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `raised` | `bg-surface-raised border-border`. |
| `sunken` | `bg-surface-sunken border-border`. |
| `transparent` | `bg-transparent border-transparent`. |

Styled cards also get `rounded-card border`.

## States

Static container. No interactive or conditional states in code.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

none in source.

## A11y

- Contrast: Non-interactive surface. Border border-border on raised/sunken is 1.58/1.58:1 / 1.42/1.75:1; decorative, no 1.4.11 requirement. Text inside is the caller's.
- Keyboard and focus: Not focusable, no handlers.
- Touch target: Not interactive.
- Screen reader: Plain View, no role, no label. Correct for a presentation container.
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **PASS**. Static container with no interactive or text content of its own.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=Card
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { Card } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Card";

export function Summary() {
  return (
    <Card surface="sunken" padded>
      <Text>Last sync 09:41</Text>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pick `surface` of `sunken` to set a card apart from a `raised` page area, since both keep the `border-border` outline.
- Leave `padded` at its default `true` for content cards, which adds `p-4`, and set it to false only when a child supplies its own padding.

### Don't

- Do not set `unstyled` and expect the radius or border, because it removes all default classes including `rounded-card`.
- Do not put tap handlers on `Card` and expect a button, because it is a plain View with no role and the a11y review marks it a static container.

# DragGrabHandle

## Purpose

Three-bar drag handle, 44 by 44 minimum, reporting start, move, commit and cancel through a pluggable transport, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: @nyc-tron/gestures/PanResponderDrag

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/DragGrabHandle
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { DragGrabHandle } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/DragGrabHandle";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { DragGrabHandle } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/DragGrabHandle";`

### Dependencies

- `createDragController` and `DragController` from `./gestures/drag-controller.ts`; `keyboardKey`, `DragPoint`, `DragTransport`, `KeyEventLike` from `./gestures/drag-transport.ts`; `PanResponderDrag` from `./gestures/PanResponderDrag.tsx`.
- `joinClasses`.
- react-native (peer, required): Platform, View, PanResponder (inside PanResponderDrag).
- `GestureHandlerDrag` (react-native-gesture-handler, optional peer) is not imported here; it is only a value a caller may pass as `transport`.

## Props

`DragGrabHandleProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"accessibilityLabel">`. `style` is merged after the built-in min size, opacity and `userSelect`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children" | "accessibilityLabel">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | none | yes | Sets `accessibilityLabel`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Opacity 0.4, `aria-disabled`. Read on every drag transition. |
| `onStart` | `() => void` | none | yes | A drag began. |
| `onMove` | `(point: DragPoint) => void` | none | yes | Preview only; single pointer. |
| `onCommit` | `() => void` | none | yes | Once per completed drag. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | none | yes | Escape, termination, a second pointer or becoming disabled. |
| `transport` | `DragTransport` | `PanResponderDrag` | no | Pointer recogniser component. |
| `color` | `string` | none | no | Sets `borderColor` of the grip bars. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Replaces the three-bar grip. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Removes `rounded-control` and the `border-text-muted` bar class. |

`DragPoint` (re-exported from gestures/drag-transport.ts):

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| x | `number` | none | yes | Page (web) or absolute window (native) coordinates. |
| y | `number` | none | yes |  |

### Tokens

- `color.textMuted`: `border-text-muted` x1
- `radius.control` x1
- `size.touch`: `minWidth: 44`, `minHeight: 44`
- `space.0.75`: `gap: 3` x1
- `border.2`: `borderTopWidth: 2` x1
- `opacity.0_4`: `opacity 0.4` x1
- Inline bar width 16 and height 0: no token.

Tailwind default classes (no token): `border` x1, `rounded-control` x1.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Whether Escape reaches `onKeyDown` while the pointer is down depends on web focus behaviour described in a source comment, not shown by code.
- UNVERIFIED: Gesture recognition itself (touch slop, multi-touch counting) lives in gestures/pan-responder-config.ts, which was not read.

## Variants

none.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | derived in code | 44x44 minimum, three-bar grip. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | `disabled` prop; opacity 0.4, `aria-disabled`, the controller ignores input. |
| `dragging` | derived in code | handled by the controller (start, move preview, one commit, cancel); no visual change in this file. |
| `cancelled` | derived in code | Escape key (`onKeyDown`), second pointer, unmount, or disabled. |

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"` adds `userSelect:"none"` to the style.
- `focusable={false}`: not a tab stop, per the source comment.

## A11y

- Contrast: Grip dots border-text-muted 6.16/7.14:1 / 5.54/7.9:1 as graphic. Disabled opacity 0.4, exempt.
- Keyboard and focus: focusable={false} (:77), so the handle is not in the tab order. Escape handled by onKeyDown while a web pointer drag is active (:57). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: minWidth and minHeight 44 (:78, size.touch). Android: 44 (F08). Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: accessible, accessibilityLabel from label, accessibilityHint "Drag to move. Press Escape to cancel.", aria-disabled. No accessibilityRole and no activation action, so a screen reader user hears a label and hint for something they cannot operate (F14).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Pointer-only control; whether a keyboard or screen-reader alternative exists depends on the host (AdaptiveDock supplies a menu).
  - UNVERIFIED: Keyboard and screen-reader alternative to dragging (F14). Test: With AdaptiveDock, move a floating panel using only keyboard, then only VoiceOver or NVDA, and confirm every dock target is reachable.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=DragGrabHandle
import { DragGrabHandle } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/DragGrabHandle";

export function LayerHandle() {
  return (
    <DragGrabHandle
      label="Reorder Layer 2"
      onStart={() => {}}
      onMove={(point) => void (point.x + point.y)}
      onCommit={() => {}}
      onCancel={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass a descriptive `label`, since it becomes the `accessibilityLabel` for the only element a screen reader user reaches.
- Handle `onCancel` by discarding the preview, because it fires on Escape, termination, a second pointer or when the handle becomes `disabled`.
- Use `onMove` for preview only and apply the change in `onCommit`, which runs once per completed drag.

### Don't

- Do not ship `DragGrabHandle` as the only way to move something, because it has no activation action and screen reader users hear a hint for a control they cannot operate (F14).
- Do not assume Escape cancels a web drag reliably, because the page marks Escape reaching `onKeyDown` as UNVERIFIED.
- Do not expect it in the tab order, because `focusable` is false in the source.

# FieldGroup

## Purpose

Form layout wrapper with titled sections and footer text, exposed as FieldGroup.Section, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/FieldGroup
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/FieldGroup";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { FieldGroup } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/FieldGroup";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): Platform, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

`FieldGroup` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. It is `Object.assign(FieldGroupRoot,{Section:FieldSection})`, and `FieldSection` is also a named export.

`FieldGroupProps`:

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | none | no | Root classes `w-full min-w-0 gap-4` come first. |

`FieldSectionProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`:

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| title | `string` | none | no | Header Text (accessibilityRole header; web `aria-level` 3) and the group's `aria-label`. |
| footer | `string` | none | no | Text under the body. |
| children | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| titleUppercase | `boolean` | `false` | no | Adds `uppercase tracking-wide`. |
| className | `string` | none | no |  |
| titleClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| bodyClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| unstyled | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.border` x2, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.text` x1, `color.textMuted` x1
- `radius.control` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `min-w-0` x2, `gap-4`, `border` x6, `px-3` x2, `py-2`, `text-sm` x2, `font-semibold`, `gap-3`, `p-3`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Screen reader announcement of `role="group"` with `aria-label` on native: the doc comment states it, the file does not prove it.

## Variants

none.

## States

Static layout. No interactive states in code.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"` adds `aria-level: 3` to the section title.

## A11y

- Contrast: Title text-text and helper text-text-muted on raised 17.79/13.83:1 / 6.16/7.14:1; group border 1.58/1.58:1, decorative.
- Keyboard and focus: Static.
- Touch target: Not interactive.
- Screen reader: FieldSection role=group with aria-label=title (:36); title accessibilityRole=header with aria-level 3 on web (:40).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **PASS**. Grouping and heading semantics present.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=FieldGroup
import { useState } from "react";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/FieldGroup";
import { TextField } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/TextField";

export function DocumentDetails() {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  return (
    <FieldGroup>
      <FieldGroup.Section title="Document details" footer="Visible to collaborators." titleUppercase>
        <TextField id="title" label="Title" value={title} onChangeText={setTitle} />
      </FieldGroup.Section>
    </FieldGroup>
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Use `FieldGroup.Section` with a `title`, since it sets both the header text and the group `aria-label`.
- Pass `footer` for helper text under the body, which keeps it in the same labelled group.
- Set `titleUppercase` for compact section headers, which adds `uppercase tracking-wide`.

### Don't

- Do not put interactive state expectations on `FieldGroup`, because it is static layout with no focus or pressed code.
- Do not claim native screen readers announce the group name, because the page marks `role="group"` with `aria-label` UNVERIFIED.

# IconButton

## Purpose

Icon-only pressable button with five variants and an optional selected toggle state, for React Native; web aria-pressed.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/IconButton
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { IconButton } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/IconButton";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { IconButton } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/IconButton";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): Platform, Pressable, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

Extends `Omit<PressableProps,"children"|"disabled"|"style">`. Read specially: `onPress`, `accessibilityState` (merged; `disabled` overwritten, `selected` added when `selected` is defined). `style` is redeclared as `PressableProps["style"]`.

Extends: `Omit<PressableProps, "children" | "disabled" | "style">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | none | yes | Wrapped in a View with `aria-hidden`. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | none | yes | Sets both `aria-label` and `accessibilityLabel`. |
| `accessibilityHint` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `variant` | `IconButtonVariant` | `"ghost"` | no |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"md"` | no | `sm` is `h-11 w-11` (44), `md` is `h-12 w-12` (48). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Adds `opacity-50`. |
| `targetSize` | `number` | none | no | Throws RangeError unless finite and at least 44. Sets minWidth and minHeight. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | none | no | Toggle state. Undefined means not a toggle. |
| `cornerRadius` | `number` | none | no | Inline `borderRadius`. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `style` | `PressableProps["style"]` | none | no | Function or value; merged after the built-in min size and radius. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.primary`: `bg-primary` x1 and `bg-primary/10` x1
- `color.border`: x4
- `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.surfaceSunken` x1, `color.danger` x2, `color.focus` x1
- `radius.control`: x1
- Inline `minWidth/minHeight` 44 and 48: no token (tokenuse reports none for this file).

Tailwind default classes (no token): `border` x12, `h-11`, `w-11`, `h-12`, `w-12`, `opacity-80`, `opacity-50`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Screen reader output when both `aria-label` and `accessibilityLabel` are set: depends on the host's RN version and platform, not on code in this file.

## Variants

### variant

| Value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `primary` | `bg-primary border-border`. |
| `secondary` | `bg-surface-raised border-border`. |
| `outline` | `bg-transparent border-border`. |
| `ghost` | `bg-transparent border-transparent hover:bg-surface-sunken`. |
| `danger` | `bg-danger border-danger`. |

`size`: `sm` gives `h-11 w-11` and min 44; `md` gives `h-12 w-12` and min 48.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `pressed` | class `active:opacity-80` | `active:opacity-80` class. |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-sunken` | `hover:bg-surface-sunken` on the `ghost` variant only. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | `disabled` prop; `accessibilityState.disabled`, `opacity-50`. |
| `selected` | `selected` prop | `selected` prop; `accessibilityState.selected`, and on web `aria-pressed`. On non-primary, non-danger variants it swaps the variant class for `bg-primary/10 border-border forced-colors:border-[Highlight]`. |

### Motion

`active:opacity-80`, `motion-reduce:transition-none`. No Animated calls.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"` adds `aria-pressed` when `selected` is defined.

## A11y

- Contrast: Selected non-primary variants use bg-primary/10 with border-border: tint 1.15/1.2:1, border 1.58/1.58:1, both under 3:1 (F04; forced-colors gets border-[Highlight]). Primary and danger fills: icon colour is the caller's, so glyph contrast is UNVERIFIED. Ring 5.81/6.93:1.
- Keyboard and focus: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:55). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: sm 44, md 48 as minWidth and minHeight plus h-11/h-12 (:46, :54); targetSize overrides. sm is size.touch. Android: sm 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. md passes. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: accessibilityRole=button, aria-label and accessibilityLabel both set, optional hint, accessibilityState disabled and selected, aria-pressed on web (:49-51). Icon wrapper aria-hidden.
- Motion: `motion-reduce:transition-none` with no transition class (F09).
- Review status: **FAIL**. Selected state is a 1.15/1.2:1 tint (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=IconButton
import { useState } from "react";
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/IconButton";

export function PinToggle() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  return (
    <IconButton
      aria-label="Pin pane"
      icon={<Text>P</Text>}
      variant="ghost"
      size="sm"
      selected={pinned}
      onPress={() => setPinned(!pinned)}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Always pass `aria-label`, since it is required and sets both `aria-label` and `accessibilityLabel` for an icon-only control.
- Use `size` of `md` on Android, because `sm` is 44 and 4dp under the 48dp guideline (F08).
- Set `selected` only for real toggles, since undefined means not a toggle and it drives `aria-pressed` on web.

### Don't

- Do not use `selected` on `outline`, `secondary` or `ghost` as the only cue, because the `bg-primary/10` tint is 1.15:1 and the review is FAIL (F04).
- Do not pass `targetSize` below 44 or non-finite, because it throws a RangeError.
- Do not assume icon contrast on `primary` or `danger` fills, because the icon color is the caller's and the page marks it UNVERIFIED.

# List

## Purpose

Vertical list of rows with title, supporting text, leading and trailing slots; rows with onPress become buttons, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/List
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { List, ListItem } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/List";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { List, ListItem } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/List";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): Children use via react, Platform, Pressable, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

`ListProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`:

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children" | "role">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Only valid elements are kept; each is wrapped in a `role="listitem"` View. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`ListItemProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`:

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| children | `ReactNode` | none | no | A string or number renders as the title Text. |
| supportingText | `string` | none | no |  |
| leading | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| trailing | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| onPress | `()=>void` | none | no | Renders a Pressable (accessibilityRole button) instead of a View. |
| selected | `boolean` | none | no | Adds `bg-primary/10`; sets `accessibilityState.selected`. |
| disabled | `boolean` | `false` | no | Only applied in the Pressable branch. |
| accessibilityHint | `string` | none | no | Pressable branch only. |
| className | `string` | none | no |  |
| titleClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| supportingClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| unstyled | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.border` x2, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.text` x1, `color.textMuted` x1, `color.primary` x1 (`bg-primary/10`), `color.focus` x1, `color.surfaceSunken` x1
- `radius.control` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `min-w-0` x2, `rounded-control`, `border` x7, `text-base`, `gap-0` (from `gap-0.5`), `text-sm`, `gap-1`, `min-h-11`, `gap-3`, `px-3`, `py-2`, `border-2`, `opacity-80`, `opacity-50`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Spoken name of a pressable row whose `children` is not a string or number: `accessibilityLabel` is then undefined and the result depends on the host reading child text.

## Variants

none.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | derived in code | row classes. |
| `pressed` | class `active:opacity-80` | `active:opacity-80` (Pressable branch). |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-sunken` | `hover:bg-surface-sunken` when pressable and not selected. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-focus`. |
| `disabled` | derived in code | `disabled` prop, `opacity-50`, `accessibilityState.disabled`. |
| `selected` | derived in code | `selected` prop; `bg-primary/10`, forced-colors border, `accessibilityState.selected`, on web `aria-current="true"` in the Pressable branch. |

### Motion

`active:opacity-80`, `motion-reduce:transition-none`. No Animated calls.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"` adds `aria-current` on a selected pressable row.

## A11y

- Contrast: title text-text 17.79/13.83:1, supporting text-text-muted 6.16/7.14:1. Selected row bg-primary/10 vs raised 1.15/1.2:1 (F04). Hover bg-surface-sunken vs raised 1.11/1.11:1 is hover only.
- Keyboard and focus: Pressable rows: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-inset ring-focus` (:80, 5.81/6.93:1). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Rows min-h-11 (:69, 44, no token). Android: 44 (F08). Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: role=list and listitem (:39, :42). Pressable row: accessibilityRole=button, label from children plus supporting text, hint, state disabled and selected, aria-current on web (:75-78). A non-pressable selected row sets accessibilityState on a View that is not accessible, so iOS ignores it (:70-71).
- Motion: `motion-reduce:transition-none` with no transition (F09).
- Review status: **FAIL**. Selected row marked by a 1.15/1.2:1 tint (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=List
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { List, ListItem } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/List";

export function SettingsList({ onOpen }: { onOpen: () => void }) {
  return (
    <List aria-label="Settings">
      <ListItem supportingText="Light, dark or system" leading={<Text>A</Text>} onPress={onOpen} selected>
        Appearance
      </ListItem>
      <ListItem trailing={<Text>On</Text>}>Notifications</ListItem>
    </List>
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `onPress` for tappable rows, since it renders a Pressable with `accessibilityRole` button and the `accessibilityHint` is applied there.
- Give pressable rows string or number `children`, because the accessible label is built from them plus `supportingText`.
- Add `aria-label` on `List` to name the group, since the root carries `role="list"`.

### Don't

- Do not use `selected` alone to mark the current row, because `bg-primary/10` is 1.15:1 (F04) and the review is FAIL (1.4.11).
- Do not set `selected` on a row without `onPress` and expect iOS to announce it, because the state lands on a View that is not accessible.
- Do not set `disabled` on a non-pressable row, because it only applies in the Pressable branch.

# NavigationRail

## Purpose

Vertical rail of icon and label destinations with selected state and a collapsed icon-only mode, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/NavigationRail
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { NavigationRail, NavigationShell } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/NavigationRail";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { NavigationRail, NavigationShell } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/NavigationRail";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): Pressable, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

`NavigationRailProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `selectedId` | `string \| null` | none | yes |  |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(id: string) => void` | none | yes | Called on every press, including the selected item. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Hides labels only; rail width `w-16` instead of `w-52`. |

| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |

`NavigationItem` (readonly fields):

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | `string` | none | yes |  |
| label | `string` | none | yes | Also item `accessibilityLabel`. |

| disabled | `boolean` | none | no |  |

`NavigationShellProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`:

|---|---|---|---|---|

### Tokens

- `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.border` x2, `color.focus` x1, `color.primary` x1, `color.onPrimary` x1, `color.text` x1
- `radius.control` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `gap-1`, `w-16`, `w-52`, `py-3`, `border` x6, `min-h-11`, `gap-2`, `rounded-control`, `px-3`, `opacity-40`, `text-sm`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: The rail uses `accessibilityRole="tablist"` and `"tab"`, which is a selection pattern. How each platform's screen reader exposes tabs here is not provable from source.
- UNVERIFIED: No keyboard arrow handling exists in this file; keyboard behaviour rests on the host's focus handling for Pressable.

## Variants

none.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `selected` | derived in code | `id===selectedId`; `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`, `accessibilityState.selected`. |
| `unselected` | derived in code | `bg-transparent`, `text-text`. |
| `disabled` | derived in code | `item.disabled`; `opacity-40`, `accessibilityState.disabled`. |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` prop | `collapsed` prop. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`. |
| `hover, pressed` | derived in code | no code. |

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

none in source. `NavigationShell` pins the outer row to `direction:"ltr"` so RTL does not mirror the rail edge.

## A11y

- Contrast: Selected bg-primary and text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; others text-text 17.79/13.83:1. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).
- Keyboard and focus: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:56). No roving handler, so every tab is a Tab stop. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Items min-h-11 (:55, 44, no token). Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: tablist and tab roles with accessibilityState selected and disabled (:43-53). It is a destination list with no tabpanel, so tab is the wrong role for navigation (F17). Icons hidden.
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Focus ring and selected fill share one colour (1/1:1) (F07).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility on the selected item (F07). Test: Tab to the selected item in light and dark and compare the focused and unfocused screenshots.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=NavigationRail
import { useState } from "react";
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { NavigationRail, NavigationShell } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/NavigationRail";

export function AppShell() {
  const [id, setId] = useState<string | null>("home");
  return (
    <NavigationShell
      edge="left"
      rail={
        <NavigationRail
          edge="left"
          selectedId={id}
          onSelectionChange={setId}
          collapsed={false}
          items={[
            { id: "home", label: "Home", icon: <Text>H</Text> },
            { id: "files", label: "Files", disabled: true },
          ]}
        />
      }
    >
      <Text>Content</Text>
    </NavigationShell>
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `edge` on both `NavigationRail` and `NavigationShell` to the same side, because it chooses `border-l` or `border-r` and the `rail` slot position.
- Give every item a clear `label`, since it doubles as the item `accessibilityLabel` while `icon` is hidden from accessibility.

### Don't

- Don't assume `collapsed` removes labels from screen readers; it hides labels only and the `label` still names the item.
- Don't treat the selected item's focus ring as proven visible: `ring-focus` matches the `bg-primary` fill at 1/1:1 (F07) and the page marks it `UNVERIFIED`.
- Don't claim arrow-key navigation works; the page says no roving handler exists, so every `tablist` tab is a Tab stop.

# SegmentedControl

## Purpose

Single-choice segmented control exposed as a radio group, for React Native; arrow-key navigation on web only.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/SegmentedControl
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/SegmentedControl";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { SegmentedControl } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/SegmentedControl";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses` from `./styles.ts`; `domIsRTL`, `isModified`, `nextChoiceIndex`, `rovingStop`, `webKey` from `./forms/choice-keys.ts`.
- react-native (peer, required): I18nManager, Platform, Pressable, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

Generic: `SegmentedControl<T extends string=string>`. `SegmentedControlProps<T>` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`; `style` is merged after `flexDirection:"row",flexWrap:"wrap"`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children" | "role">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `readonly SegmentedOption<T>[]` | none | yes | Expanded below. |
| `value` | `T \| ""` | none | yes | A value matching no option leaves every segment unchecked. |
| `onChange` | `(value: T) => void` | none | yes | Not called when the pressed option is already selected or is disabled. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | none | no | Names the radiogroup. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Disables every segment; sets `aria-disabled` on the group. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `segmentClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `segmentStyle` | `StyleProp<ViewStyle> \| ((state: { selected: boolean; disabled: boolean; pressed: boolean; }) => StyleProp<ViewStyle>)` | none | no |  |
| `labelStyle` | `StyleProp<TextStyle>` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`SegmentedOption<T>`:

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| value | `T` | none | yes |  |
| label | `string` | none | yes |  |
| disabled | `boolean` | none | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.border` x1, `color.surfaceSunken` x1, `color.focus` x1, `color.primary` x1, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.onPrimary` x1, `color.text` x1
- `radius.control` x2
- `size.touch`: `minHeight: 44` x1, `minWidth: 44` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `gap-0` (from `gap-0.5`), `rounded-control` x2, `border` x4, `p-0` (from `p-0.5`), `min-h-11`, `min-w-11`, `px-3`, `py-1` (from `py-1.5`), `border-2`, `opacity-50`, `text-sm`, `font-medium`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Native screen reader traversal of `role="radio"` segments: the doc comment claims every segment is reachable; not provable from source.

## Variants

none.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `selected` | derived in code | segment matching `value`; `aria-checked`, `accessibilityState.checked`, `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | group `disabled` or option `disabled`; `opacity-50`, `accessibilityState.disabled`, skipped by keys. |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-raised` | `hover:bg-surface-raised` on unselected segments. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`. |
| `pressed` | derived in code | only through the `segmentStyle` function state. |

### Motion

`motion-reduce:transition-none`. No Animated calls.

### Platform notes

- Web only: `onKeyDown` and `tabIndex` are attached when `Platform.OS==="web"`. Checked segment has tabIndex 0, others -1. Arrow keys move and select with wrap, flipped in RTL (`I18nManager.isRTL` or DOM direction), Home/End jump, disabled skipped, modifier keys ignored.
- Native: no key handling in the file.

## A11y

- Contrast: Active segment bg-primary with text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; inactive text-text on sunken 16.01/15.31:1. Container border 1.42/1.75:1, decorative. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).
- Keyboard and focus: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:80). Web: roving tabIndex and arrow keys (:78, :53). Native: no key handler. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: minHeight and minWidth 44 inline (:74) and min-h-11 min-w-11. Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: radiogroup with aria-label or aria-labelledby; each segment role=radio with checked and disabled state (:63-72).
- Motion: `motion-reduce:transition-none` with no transition (F09).
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Focus ring and selected fill share one colour (1/1:1) (F07).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility on the active segment (F07). Test: Tab into the group, screenshot, compare with the unfocused state.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=SegmentedControl
import { useState } from "react";
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/SegmentedControl";

type View = "list" | "grid";

export function ViewSwitch() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("list");
  return (
    <SegmentedControl<View>
      aria-label="Layout"
      value={view}
      onChange={setView}
      options={[
        { value: "list", label: "List" },
        { value: "grid", label: "Grid", disabled: false },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` so the radiogroup has a name.
- Use `segmentStyle` as a function when you need the `pressed` state, since that is the only route to it.

### Don't

- Don't expect `onChange` for the already selected option or a disabled one; it is not called.
- Don't rely on arrow keys on native: key handling and `tabIndex` attach only when `Platform.OS` is web.
- Don't assume the focused active segment shows a ring; `ring-focus` equals the `bg-primary` fill at 1/1:1 (F07), still `UNVERIFIED`.

# Select

## Purpose

Single-select dropdown with flat or grouped options, hint and error text, for React Native; web combobox ARIA; QNX keyboard.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/Select
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { Select } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Select";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { Select } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/Select";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses`, `isModified`, `nextChoiceIndex`, `typeaheadIndex`, `webKey`, `flattenOptionGroups`, `validateOptionGroups` (same package).
- react-native (peer, required): Platform, Pressable, ScrollView, Text, View.
- `zustand` (`useStore`, `createStore` from `zustand/vanilla`): optional peer in package.json but imported unconditionally by this file.
- `react`: useId, useRef.

## Props

`SelectProps = SelectBaseProps & (SelectOptionsChoice | SelectGroupsChoice)`. `SelectBaseProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`; `testID` is read, rest spread to the root View. Exactly one of `options` or `groups` (passing both makes `selectOptions` throw TypeError).

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| label | `string` | none | yes | Caption and accessible name. |
| value | `string` | none | yes |  |
| onValueChange | `(value:string)=>void` | none | yes | Not called when the picked value equals `value`. |
| disabled | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| placeholder | `string` | `"Choose…"` | no | Shown when `value` matches no option. |
| hint | `string` | none | no |  |
| errorText | `string` | none | no | Replaces `hint`. |
| className | `string` | none | no |  |
| labelClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| triggerClassName | `string` | none | no |  |
| unstyled | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| options | `readonly SelectOption[]` | none | one of options/groups | Flat choice. |
| groups | `readonly SelectGroup[]` | none | one of options/groups | `OptionGroup<SelectOption>` from forms/option-groups.ts: `heading:string` (not blank), `options` (at least one). |

`SelectOption`:

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| value | `string` | none | yes |  |
| label | `string` | `value` | no | Shown text. |
| disabled | `boolean` | none | no |  |

`selectOptions(props)` returns the flat option list (validates groups, throws on both shapes).

### Tokens

- `color.primary` x1, `color.surfaceSunken` x3, `color.onPrimary` x1, `color.text` x3, `color.border` x2, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.textMuted` x4, `color.focus` x1, `color.danger` x2
- `radius.control` x2
- Inline `maxHeight: 320`, chevron `translateY` 2/-2, `45deg`/`-135deg`: no token.

Tailwind default classes (no token): `min-h-11`, `px-3` x3, `py-2`, `border-2`, `border` x11, `opacity-50` x2, `text-base` x3, `font-semibold` x3, `rounded-control` x2, `shadow-md`, `text-xs`, `min-w-0` x2, `gap-2` x2, `text-sm` x2, `min-h-12`, `h-2`, `w-2`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: The listbox is announced on iOS/Android as a plain `list` (the source comment says RN has no listbox role); actual spoken output is not provable here.
- UNVERIFIED: `zustand` is an optional peer yet imported at module top level: whether a missing install fails at import time depends on the consumer's bundler.

## Variants

none.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `closed/open` | derived in code | internal zustand store `{open,active}`; trigger `accessibilityState.expanded`, web `aria-expanded`. |
| `selected option` | derived in code | `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary font-semibold`, `aria-selected`. |
| `active (keyboard highlight) option` | derived in code | `bg-surface-sunken`. |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-sunken` | `hover:bg-surface-sunken` on options. |
| `error` | derived in code | `errorText`; `border-danger`, message Text with `accessibilityRole="alert"`, web `aria-invalid`. |
| `disabled` | derived in code | select `disabled` or option `disabled`; `opacity-50`. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` on the trigger. |

### Motion

Chevron rotates via inline `transform` based on `open`; no transition or Animated call in source.

### Platform notes

- `web` (`Platform.OS==="web"`): select-only combobox ARIA (`aria-haspopup`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, listbox role), list absolutely positioned under the trigger, `onMouseDown` preventDefault on options, keyboard handler.
- `qnx` or `marathon` (`String(Platform.OS)`): keyboard handler and `onBlur` hide are attached, list container gets `accessible`, options get `focusable:false`.
- Other native: list opens in flow under the trigger; no key handling.
- Keys when open: ArrowUp/Down (no wrap), Home/End, typeahead, Enter/Space pick, Escape close, Tab close.

## A11y

- Contrast: Trigger on bg-surface-sunken with border-border: 1.42/1.75:1 (F03). Option states: selected bg-primary with text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; keyboard-active option bg-surface-sunken vs list bg-surface-raised 1.11/1.11:1; an option that is both active and selected shows only the selected fill, so the active cue is gone (:152) (F02). Error text-danger 6.57/7.24:1.
- Keyboard and focus: Trigger `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:189). Web and QNX use aria-activedescendant with Enter, Space, Arrows, Escape, Tab, typeahead (:109-131); options are not focused. Native uses taps. QNX branch at :80.
- Touch target: Trigger min-h-12 (:188, 48, no token) passes both; options min-h-11 (:150, 44). Android options: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: Web: combobox with aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-invalid, aria-describedby; listbox, option, group with heading (:135-186). Native: label plus shown value, hint, state expanded and disabled. Error is role alert with a polite live region (:202).
- Motion: No animation.
- Review status: **FAIL**. Keyboard-active option has a 1.11/1.11:1 cue and none when selected (2.4.7); trigger boundary under 3:1 (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=Select
import { useState } from "react";
import { Select } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Select";

export function UnitSelect() {
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState("");
  return (
    <Select
      label="Unit"
      value={unit}
      onValueChange={setUnit}
      placeholder="Choose a unit"
      hint="Applies to new documents."
      groups={[
        { heading: "Metric", options: [{ value: "mm", label: "Millimetres" }, { value: "cm" }] },
        { heading: "Imperial", options: [{ value: "in", label: "Inches" }] },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass either `options` or `groups`, never both, because `selectOptions` throws `TypeError` when both are set.
- Set `errorText` to show a failure, since it replaces `hint` and renders a message with `accessibilityRole="alert"`.

### Don't

- Don't depend on the keyboard-active option cue: `bg-surface-sunken` against the list is 1.11/1.11:1 and vanishes when the option is selected (2.4.7, FAIL).
- Don't rely on the trigger border for contrast; `border-border` on `bg-surface-sunken` is 1.42/1.75:1 (F03).
- Don't assume iOS and Android announce a listbox; the page marks the plain `list` announcement `UNVERIFIED`.

# TabBar

## Purpose

Tab strip with tablist or link-navigation semantics, icons and compact density, for React Native; web roving focus.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/TabBar
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { TabBar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/TabBar";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { TabBar } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/TabBar";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses`; `domIsRTL`, `isModified`, `nextChoiceIndex`, `rovingStop`, `webKey` (same package).
- react-native (peer, required): I18nManager, Platform, Pressable, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

`TabBarProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children" | "role">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | `readonly TabBarTab[]` | none | yes | Expanded below. |
| `semantics` | `"tabs" \| "navigation"` | `"tabs"` | no | Changes roles, see Variants. |
| `density` | `"navigation" \| "compact"` | `"navigation"` | no |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `"Navigation"` | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `tabClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`TabBarTab`:

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| key | `string` | none | yes |  |
| label | `string` | none | yes | Also the tab `aria-label`. |
| icon | `ReactNode | ((state:TabIconState)=>ReactNode)` | none | no | `TabIconState` is `{readonly active:boolean}`. |
| active | `boolean` | none | no |  |
| disabled | `boolean` | none | no |  |
| onPress | `()=>void` | none | no |  |
| href | `string` | none | no | Used as `href` only when `semantics="navigation"` on web. |

### Tokens

- `color.border` x1, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.focus` x1, `color.primary` x1, `color.surfaceSunken` x1, `color.onPrimary` x1, `color.textMuted` x1
- `radius.control` x1

Tailwind default classes (no token): `min-w-0` x4, `gap-0` (from `gap-0.5`), `border` x4, `px-1` x2, `py-1` x2, `min-h-11`, `min-w-11`, `gap-1` x2, `px-2`, `min-h-14`, `border-2`, `opacity-50`, `text-sm`, `font-medium`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: Whether `href` on a Pressable renders an anchor on web is behaviour of react-native-web, not code in this file.

## Variants

`semantics`:
- `tabs`: container `role="tablist"`, tabs `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, `accessibilityState.selected`.
- `navigation`: container `role="navigation"`, tabs `role="link"`, web `aria-current="page"` on active, no selected state.

`density`:
- `navigation`: container `w-full min-w-0 flex-row items-stretch`; styled adds `border-t border-border bg-surface-raised px-1 py-1`; tab `flex-1 gap-1 px-1 py-1.5 min-h-14`.
- `compact`: container `min-w-0 shrink flex-row items-stretch`; styled adds `gap-0.5`; tab `min-w-0 shrink grow-0 basis-auto flex-row gap-1.5 px-2`, label `min-w-0 shrink`.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `active` | derived in code | `active` on a tab; `bg-primary`, `text-on-primary`. |
| `inactive` | class `hover:bg-surface-sunken` | `bg-transparent`, `text-text-muted`, `hover:bg-surface-sunken`. |
| `disabled` | derived in code | `disabled` on a tab; `opacity-50`, `aria-disabled`. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`. |
| `pressed` | derived in code | no code. |

### Motion

`motion-reduce:transition-none`. No Animated calls.

### Platform notes

- Web only (`Platform.OS==="web"`): `aria-current`; in `tabs` mode `onKeyDown` and roving `tabIndex` (active tab 0, others -1); `href` in `navigation` mode.
- Arrow keys flip in RTL via `I18nManager.isRTL` or DOM direction; Home/End jump; focus moves via ref `.focus()`, then calls the target tab's `onPress`.

## A11y

- Contrast: Active tab bg-primary with text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; inactive text-text-muted 6.16/7.14:1. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).
- Keyboard and focus: `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:92). Web: roving tabIndex and arrows in tabs mode (:57, :87). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: min-h-11 min-w-11 (:89), non-compact min-h-14 (56, :91). Android compact: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: tabs: tablist and tab with aria-selected; navigation: role=navigation with link items and aria-current=page (:69-87).
- Motion: `motion-reduce:transition-none` with no transition (F09).
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Active fill and ring share one colour (F07).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility on the active tab (F07). Test: Tab to the active tab and compare screenshots.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=TabBar
import { useState } from "react";
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { TabBar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/TabBar";

export function PaneTabs() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("layers");
  return (
    <TabBar
      aria-label="Inspector"
      density="compact"
      tabs={[
        { key: "layers", label: "Layers", active: active === "layers", onPress: () => setActive("layers"),
          icon: ({ active: on }) => <Text>{on ? "L" : "l"}</Text> },
        { key: "assets", label: "Assets", active: active === "assets", onPress: () => setActive("assets") },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Use `semantics="navigation"` with `href` for link tabs; it gives `aria-current="page"` instead of `aria-selected`.
- Give every tab a unique `key` and a `label`, which also becomes the tab `aria-label`.
- Set `aria-label` to a meaningful name when several bars exist; the default is 'Navigation'.

### Don't

- Do not assume the active tab shows focus; `bg-primary` and `ring-focus` are one colour (F07), unverified.
- Do not set `href` expecting links in `semantics="tabs"`; it applies only with `navigation` on web, and react-native-web behaviour is UNVERIFIED.
- Do not rely on `density="compact"` for Android touch size; it is 44, 4dp under the 48dp guideline (F08).

### Tarball install

## Props

All other props are spread onto the TextInput. `accessibilityLabel`, `accessibilityLabelledBy` and `accessibilityHint` are set after the spread and override caller values.

| `className` | `string` | none | no | Outer View. |
| `inputClassName` | `string` | none | no | TextInput. |
| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |

| `ref` | `Ref<ComponentRef<typeof TextInput>>` | none | no | Forwarded to the TextInput. |

### Tokens

## A11y

- Contrast: Field bg-surface-sunken with border-border 1.42/1.75:1 (F03); error border-danger and text-danger 5.91/8.01:1; label text-text 17.79/13.83:1; helper text-text-muted 6.16/7.14:1.
- Keyboard and focus: Native input; no focus style on the field wrapper in this file (the platform caret or outline applies) (GU1). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Wrapper min-h-12 (:31, 48) passes both; input min-h-11 (:43).
- Screen reader: Label Text with nativeID, input accessibilityLabel, accessibilityLabelledBy, hint = error else helper, disabled state; error role alert with a polite live region (:36-46).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **FAIL**. Field boundary 1.42/1.75:1 (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=TextField
import { useState } from "react";
import { TextField } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/TextField";

export function NameField() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  return (
    <TextField
      id="doc-name"
      label="Document name"
      helperText="Shown in the title bar."
      errorText={name.length > 40 ? "Use 40 characters or fewer." : undefined}
      value={name}
      onChangeText={setName}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass a unique `id` and `label`; the label `nativeID` is `id + "-label"` and `label` is the input's `accessibilityLabel`.
- Use `errorText` for validation; it replaces `helperText`, turns the border `border-danger` and announces as an alert.
- Use `startAdornment` for a leading icon inside the border box.

### Don't

- Do not rely on the field border alone; `border-border` on `bg-surface-sunken` is 1.42/1.75:1 (F03) and the status is FAIL.
- Do not expect a focus style; the file adds none and the platform caret or outline applies (GU1).
- Do not assume `accessibilityLabelledBy` reads the same on every platform; that is UNVERIFIED.

# Toolbar

## Purpose

Header bar with title, leading slot and actions group in default or compact density; arrow-key focus on web, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/Toolbar
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { Toolbar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Toolbar";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { Toolbar } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/Toolbar";`

### Dependencies

- `joinClasses`; `arrowStep`, `domIsRTL`, `isModified`, `webKey` (same package).
- react-native (peer, required): I18nManager, Platform, Text, View.
- No optional peers.

## Props

`ToolbarProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children"|"role">`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children" | "role">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | none | no | Header Text, one line. Without it a flex spacer View fills the gap. |
| `leading` | `ReactNode` | none | no |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Wrapped in `role="toolbar"`. |
| `density` | `"default" \| "compact"` | `"default"` | no |  |
| `actionsLabel` | `string` | none | no | Falls back to `<title> actions`, or `Actions` without a title. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `titleClassName` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

### Tokens

- `color.border` x1, `color.surfaceRaised` x1, `color.text` x2 (`border-b border-border bg-surface-raised` when styled)
- No radius token.

Tailwind default classes (no token): `min-w-0` x2, `gap-2`, `min-h-13`, `px-2`, `min-h-14`, `px-4`, `border` x3, `gap-1` x2, `text-sm`, `font-semibold` x2, `text-lg`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: `min-h-13` is used in the source but defined nowhere in the files read; whether it resolves depends on the consumer's Tailwind config.

## Variants

`density`:
- `default`: `min-h-14 px-4`; title `text-lg font-semibold text-text`; web `aria-level` 2.
- `compact`: `min-h-13 px-2`; title `text-sm font-semibold text-text`; web `aria-level` 3.

## States

Static bar. No interactive state on the bar itself.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- Web only: title `aria-level`, and an `onKeyDown` on the actions group moving focus among focusable descendants (`button:not([disabled]),a[href],[role="button"]:not([aria-disabled="true"]),[tabindex="0"]`) with arrows (RTL-aware), Home and End, with wrap.

## A11y

- Contrast: Title text-text 17.79/13.83:1 on bg-surface-raised; border 1.58/1.58:1 decorative.
- Keyboard and focus: Web: arrow keys move focus between actions (:21-29, :65). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Bar min-h-13 or min-h-14 (:54); actions are the caller's.
- Screen reader: Title accessibilityRole=header with aria-level on web; actions role=toolbar labelled (:58-65).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **PASS**. Toolbar and heading semantics with arrow-key movement.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=Toolbar
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/IconButton";
import { Toolbar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/Toolbar";

export function PaneHeader() {
  return (
    <Toolbar
      title="Layers"
      density="compact"
      actionsLabel="Layer actions"
      leading={<IconButton aria-label="Back" icon={<Text>{"<"}</Text>} onPress={() => {}} />}
      actions={<IconButton aria-label="Add layer" icon={<Text>+</Text>} onPress={() => {}} />}
    />
  );
}
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `actionsLabel` when `title` is absent or several toolbars exist; the fallback is `<title> actions` or `Actions`.
- Use `density="compact"` for tight headers; it uses `min-h-13` and a smaller title.
- Pass `actions` focusable children, since arrow keys move among them on web.

### Don't

- Do not assume `min-h-13` resolves; it is defined nowhere in the files read and depends on your Tailwind config (UNVERIFIED).
- Do not put `role` on the root; `ToolbarProps` omits it.
- Do not omit `title` expecting a heading; without it only a spacer renders.

# KeyValueList

## Purpose

Label and value list that goes from one to two columns at a measured width, with empty-value text, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/content/KeyValueList
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { KeyValueList } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/content/KeyValueList";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { KeyValueList } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/content/KeyValueList";`

### Dependencies

- `react-native`: `Text`, `View`, `LayoutChangeEvent`, `ViewProps`.
- `zustand` (`zustand/vanilla`, `zustand`): `createStore`, `useStore`. Declared an optional peer in packages/ui/package.json.
- `../styles.ts`: `joinClasses`.
- Colours follow the nearest `NightScope` (per the `surface` doc comment).

## Props

Tier-1 reason: R2 core family (content)
Import count: 0

`KeyValueListProps extends Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. Read: `onLayout` (called after the internal measurement). The rest is forwarded to the root `View`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `readonly KeyValueItem[]` | none | yes | One list item per entry, keyed by `item.key`. |
| `columns` | `1 \| 2` | 2 | no | Upper bound on columns. |
| `twoColumnMinWidth` | `number` | 600 | no | Measured list width at or above which two columns are used (when `columns` is 2). |
| `emptyLabel` | `string` | "Not set" | no | Text for a `null` or `undefined` value. |
| `surface` | `"page" \| "night"` | none | no | Accepted and discarded (`surface:_surface`). |
| `className` | `string` | none | no | Joined onto the root classes. |
| `labelClassName` | `string` | none | no | Joined onto the label `Text`. |
| `valueClassName` | `string` | none | no | Joined onto the value `Text` for string and number values. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | false | no | Drops the built-in classes. |

`KeyValueItem` (same file):

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| key | string | none | yes | React key. |
| label | string | none | yes | Shown above the value. |
| value | ReactNode | none | yes | `null` or `undefined` draws `emptyLabel`. A string or number is wrapped in a selectable `Text`; any other node renders as given. |
| action | ReactNode | none | no | Rendered beside the value in a `shrink-0` wrapper. |

### Tokens

`node tokenuse.mjs` output:
- `color.textMuted` via `text-text-muted` (x2)
- `color.text` via `text-text` (x1)
- `paddingEnd: 16` is not matched by tokenuse (the file passes it as a variable expression); no token reported.

Tailwind default classes (no token): `w-full`, `flex-row`, `flex-wrap`, `gap-y-4`, `gap-0.5`, `gap-2` (x1), `min-w-0` (x1), `shrink`, `shrink-0`, `items-center`, `text-xs`, `leading-4`, `text-sm` (x2), `leading-5`, `italic`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: screen reader output for `role="list"` and `role="listitem"`; no assistive technology was run.

## Variants

- `columns`: 1 always gives each item `width: "100%"`. 2 gives `"50%"` plus `paddingEnd: 16` only when the measured width is at least `twoColumnMinWidth`; before the first layout (`width` is `null`) it is one column.
- `surface`: no effect in code.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `empty value` | derived in code | `value` is `null` or `undefined`; draws `emptyLabel` with `text-sm leading-5 text-text-muted italic` (styled). |
| `unstyled` | `unstyled` prop | `unstyled` removes the `gap-y-4`, `gap-0.5`, `text-xs leading-4 text-text-muted`, `text-sm leading-5 text-text` and empty-value classes. `labelClassName` and `valueClassName` still apply. |

No hover, pressed, focus, disabled or loading code.

### Motion

none in source

### Platform notes

none in source

## A11y

- Contrast: Label text-text-muted on page surface 6.16/7.14:1; value text-text 17.79/13.83:1.
- Keyboard and focus: Not focusable. Values use `selectable` (:73), so text can be selected with the mouse and keyboard on web.
- Touch target: Not interactive.
- Screen reader: role=list on the root and role=listitem per pair (:58,:64). Term and value are separate Text nodes in one listitem, so the pairing is by order only.
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **PASS**. Static list with contrast above 4.5:1 for both text colours.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=KeyValueList
import { KeyValueList } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/content/KeyValueList";

export const Example = () => (
  <KeyValueList
    columns={2}
    twoColumnMinWidth={560}
    emptyLabel="Not set"
    items={[
      { key: "name", label: "Name", value: "Pier 17 Gateway" },
      { key: "port", label: "Port", value: 8443 },
      { key: "owner", label: "Owner", value: null },
    ]}
  />
);
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Give every entry in `items` a unique `key`, since it is used as the React key for each pair.
- Set `emptyLabel` to wording that fits the field, because a `null` or `undefined` value renders it in muted italic text.
- Use `twoColumnMinWidth` to control when the list goes to two columns, since the measured width is compared against it.

### Don't

- Do not pass `surface` expecting a visual change, because it is accepted and discarded.
- Do not expect a two-column layout on the first render, because before the first layout the width is `null` and the list is one column.
- Do not claim screen reader pairing for `role="list"` output as verified, because the page marks it UNVERIFIED and pairing is by order only.
