| max | `number` | none | yes |  |
| step | `number` | none | yes |  |
| detents | `readonly number[]` | none | no |  |

### Tokens

- Colour classes: color.textMuted (3), color.surfaceSunken (2), color.accent (2), color.focus (2), color.text (1), color.border (1).
- radius.control (1). opacity.0_5. space.1.5 (marginTop 6), space.1 (gap 4). border.3 (indicator borderLeftWidth).
- no token: `FINE_HOLD_PX` 28, default size 72, indicator height `dialSize * 0.28`, input width 72 or 104.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): gap-1, text-sm, text-xs, border, border-2, min-h-11, min-w-11, px-2, rounded-control.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: the angle sweep and the bottom-gap hold; they live in `knobAngle`, `valueFromAngle` and `angleAround`, not read.
- UNVERIFIED: the doc comment says apps that detect a stylus pass `circular`; nothing in this file detects a stylus.
- UNVERIFIED: screen reader output for the adjustable role and hint.

## Variants

- `input="relative"`: vertical travel sets the value; sideways travel beyond 28 points from the start switches to fine adjustment and shows "Fine adjustment". Hint: "Drag up to raise the value. Move sideways while dragging for fine control."
- `input="circular"`: value follows the pointer angle around the dial centre. Hint: "Turn around the knob to set the value."

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `dragging` | derived in code | dial border `border-accent`. |
| `focused` | derived in code | dial border `border-focus`; otherwise `border-border`. |
| `fine` | derived in code | caption text while fine adjustment is active. |
| `resettable` | derived in code | "Reset" button with label "Reset <label>". |

- default; disabled (root opacity 0.5, `aria-disabled`, no accessibility actions).
- Dial is `adjustable` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext`.

### Motion

none in source. The indicator is rotated by `knobAngle` through a `transform` with no animation.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"`: dial gets `cursor` (`grab`), `userSelect: "none"`, `touchAction: "none"`.
- Arrow keys do not flip in RTL (code comment: a knob turns clockwise for Right and Up).
- Package export: `react-native` and `default` conditions both point at `dist/components/shell/RotaryKnob.js`.

## A11y

- Contrast: Dial border-2 border-border 1.42/1.75:1 idle, border-focus on focus, border-accent while previewing; needle border-accent 4.65/9.81:1. Renders UnitInput (F03).
- Keyboard and focus: focusable, onKeyDown, state-driven border-focus (:158-161). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: dialSize = max(44, size) with default size 72 (:60, :140, size.touch); reset min-h-11 min-w-11. Android: 44 floor (F08). Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: Dial accessible, role adjustable, label, hint by input mode, aria-valuemin/max/now/text, actions increment and decrement (:149-153).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **FAIL**. Renders UnitInput (F03).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=RotaryKnob
import {useState} from "react";
import {RotaryKnob} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/RotaryKnob";

export const Example=()=>{
  const [gain,setGain]=useState(0);
  return <RotaryKnob label="Gain" min={-24} max={24} step={0.5} unit="dB" defaultValue={0} value={gain} onCommit={setGain}/>;
};
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass a finite `defaultValue` inside `min` and `max`; the Reset button then shows whenever it differs from `value`.
- Pick `input="circular"` for angle-following drags and keep the default `relative` for vertical drags with fine adjustment past 28 points sideways.
- Leave `size` at 72 or set a finite value above 0 and at most 4096; the dial is never smaller than 44.

### Don't

- Do not ship it as accessible yet; the dial renders `UnitInput` (F03) and the idle `border-border` ring is 1.42/1.75:1, so the status is FAIL.
- Do not pass an `input` value other than `relative` or `circular`, or a non-finite `value`; both throw.
- Do not expect stylus detection; the doc comment says apps that detect a stylus pass `circular`, but nothing in the file detects one (UNVERIFIED).

# SliderField

## Purpose

Single-thumb slider with number field, step, detents, units and reset to default, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/gestures/PanResponderDrag, @nyc-tron/shell/UnitInput

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/SliderField
```

- Import: `import { SliderField } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/SliderField";`

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:

## Example

```tsx example=SliderField
import {useState} from "react";
import {SliderField} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/SliderField";

export const Example=()=>{
  const [value,setValue]=useState(50);
  return <SliderField label="Opacity" min={0} max={100} step={1} unit="%" defaultValue={100} value={value}
    onPreview={v=>console.log(v)} onCommit={setValue}/>;
};
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `min`, `max` and `step` explicitly, and keep `value` finite, since an invalid range or non-finite `value` throws.
- Pass `defaultValue` within range so the Reset button appears when `value` differs from it.
- Use `onPreview` for live feedback while dragging and `onCommit` for the final write.

### Don't

- Do not ship it as accessible yet; it renders `UnitInput` (F03) and the rail `border-border` is 1.42/1.75:1 (F15), so the status is FAIL.
- Do not combine `unit` and `context` expecting a drawn unit; `unit` is not drawn when `context` is given.
- Do not document Shift, Alt or PageUp changes to `step` as fact; they come from a doc comment and are UNVERIFIED.

# SplitButton

## Purpose

Primary action button joined to a dropdown menu of command items, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: @nyc-tron/overlays/CommandPopover, @nyc-tron/shell/MenuButton

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/SplitButton
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { SplitButton } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/SplitButton";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { SplitButton } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/SplitButton";`

### Dependencies

- Internal: `./MenuButton.tsx`, `../overlays/CommandPopover.tsx` (type), `../overlays/popover-position.ts` (type), `../styles.ts`.
- External: `react`, `react-native` (Pressable, Text, View).
- Optional peers: none directly; `MenuButton` uses `zustand` (optional peer).

## Props

Extends `ViewProps` minus `children`. `style` is appended after the opacity style; `testID` yields `<testID>-primary` and `<testID>-menu` on the two parts. Other ViewProps spread onto the group View.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `editScope` | `string` | `"split-button"` | no | Combined with `disabled` into the boundary and passed to `MenuButton` as its `editScope`. |
| `label` | `string` | none | yes | Primary text, primary button name and group `accessibilityLabel`. |
| `onPress` | `() => void` | none | yes | Skipped when disabled or the boundary changed. |
| `items` | `readonly CommandMenuItem[]` | none | yes | Flyout items. |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` | none | yes |  |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `` `More ${label} options` `` | no |  |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Wrapped in a `pointerEvents="none"` View. |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary"` | `"secondary"` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| `usableRegions` | `readonly Rect2D[]` | none | no | Passed to `MenuButton`. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | The `MenuButton` is always rendered `unstyled`. |

### Tokens

- Colour classes: color.onPrimary (3), color.text (2), color.primary (2), color.border (2), color.focus (2), color.surfaceSunken (1), color.surfaceRaised (1).
- radius.control (1). opacity.0_5 (disabled), opacity.0_4 (primary divider). border.1 (divider), border.1_5 (chevron right and bottom). space `-space.1` (chevron marginTop -4).
- no token: chevron 8 by 8.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): text-sm, font-semibold, border, rounded-control, min-h-11, min-w-11, gap-2, px-3.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: how the group `role="group"` plus `accessibilityLabel` is announced next to the inner button of the same name.
- UNVERIFIED: popover behaviour; it lives in `CommandPopover`, which was not read.

## Variants

- `primary`: container `border-primary bg-primary`, text `text-on-primary`, chevron and divider `border-on-primary`, divider opacity 0.4.
- `secondary`: container `border-border bg-surface-raised`, text `text-text`, chevron `border-text`, divider `border-border` at opacity 1, and `hover:bg-surface-sunken` on both buttons.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-focus` on both buttons when styled. |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-sunken` | `hover:bg-surface-sunken`, secondary only. |
| `menu expanded` | derived in code | reported by the inner `MenuButton` (`aria-expanded`). |

- default; disabled (group opacity 0.5; `disabled` on the primary button and the MenuButton).

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

none in source. Platform handling is inherited from `MenuButton` (qnx and marathon focus return).

## A11y

- Contrast: Primary variant text-on-primary on bg-primary 5.81/7.46:1; other variant text-text on raised 17.79/13.83:1; group border 1.58/1.58:1. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).
- Keyboard and focus: Both halves `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-inset ring-focus` (:54, :62). Menu half is MenuButton. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: min-h-11 min-w-11 on both halves (:53, MenuButton :88). Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: role=group labelled; primary button label; menu button label "More {label} options", aria-haspopup (:49-62).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Menu is CommandPopover (F12); primary fill and ring share a colour (F07).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility inside the menu and on the primary variant (F07, F12). Test: Tab to each half in both variants and open the menu with the keyboard.

## Example

```tsx example=SplitButton
import {SplitButton} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/SplitButton";

export const Example=()=><SplitButton label="Export" variant="primary" onPress={()=>{}}
  items={[{id:"pdf",label:"PDF"},{id:"png",label:"PNG"}]} onSelect={id=>console.log(id)}/>;
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `label`, `onPress`, `items` and `onSelect`; all four are required.
- Use `variant="primary"` for the main call to action and keep `secondary` as the default for quieter groups.
- Set `menuLabel` when the default `More ${label} options` does not describe the menu.

### Don't

- Do not assume the `primary` variant shows focus; its fill and `ring-focus` share one colour (F07) and visibility is UNVERIFIED.
- Do not assume the menu's popover behaviour or focus; it lives in `CommandPopover` and is UNVERIFIED (F12).
- Do not expect `unstyled` to restyle the menu half; the `MenuButton` is always rendered `unstyled`.

# StatusBar

## Purpose

Application status bar with zoom steps and menu, units menu, selection summary and activity text, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: @nyc-tron/shell/MenuButton

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/StatusBar
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { StatusBar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/StatusBar";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { StatusBar } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/StatusBar";`

### Dependencies

- `./MenuButton.tsx` (`@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/MenuButton`), `./status-model.ts`, `../styles.ts` (`joinClasses`), type `Rect2D` from `../overlays/popover-position.ts`.
- External: `react`, `react-native`. No optional peer is imported by this file directly.

## Props

Exports: `StatusBar`, `StatusBarProps`, `StatusZoom`, `StatusUnits`, and the re-exported types `SelectionNoun`, `StatusActivity`.

`StatusBarProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. The rest spread goes to the root `View`; `style` is appended after the component's own style. `accessibilityLabel="Status"` is set after the spread, so a caller value does not apply.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `string` | `"status"` | no | Part of the edit boundary string. |
| `revision` | `string \| number` | `0` | no | Part of the edit boundary string. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Disables both menus and both step buttons; handlers also ignore calls. |
| `zoom` | `StatusZoom` | none | no | Renders zoom step buttons plus zoom menu. |
| `units` | `StatusUnits` | none | no | Renders the units menu. |
| `selection` | `{ readonly count: number; readonly noun?: SelectionNoun; }` | none | no | Renders the selection summary text. |
| `activity` | `StatusActivity` | `{kind:"idle"}` | no | Idle, saving, rendering, recording, error. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Rendered first, before built-in items. |
| `usableRegions` | `readonly Rect2D[]` | none (doc comment: whole window) | no | Passed to both `MenuButton`s. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no | Joined onto the root class string. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Drops all token class strings. |

`StatusZoom` (in StatusBar.tsx): `value:number` (required), `presets?:readonly number[]` (default `[25,50,100,200,400]`), `onChange:(percent:number)=>void` (required), `onFit?:()=>void` (adds a "Fit to window" menu choice).

`StatusUnits`: `value:string`, `options:readonly {value:string;label:string}[]`, `onChange:(value:string)=>void`, all required.

`SelectionNoun` (shell/status-model.ts): `one:string`, `other:string`. `StatusActivity`: `{kind:"idle"}`, `{kind:"saving"}`, `{kind:"rendering";progress?:number;label?:string}`, `{kind:"recording";elapsedMs:number}`, `{kind:"error";message:string}`.

Throws `RangeError("Invalid zoom presets")` for more than 1000 presets, a non-finite or non-positive preset, or duplicates. Throws `RangeError("Invalid status units")` for more than 256 options, an empty or over-long value (256) or label (512), or duplicate values.

`node tokenuse.mjs` output for this file:
- Colour classes: `color.text` 3, `color.surfaceRaised` 3, `color.border` 2, `color.danger` 2, `color.textMuted` 1, `color.focus` 1, `color.surfaceSunken` 1, `color.accent` 1. Radius class: `radius.control` 2.
- Literals: `columnGap: 12` to `space.3` (1), `gap: 6` to `space.1.5` (1), `borderRadius: 4` to `radius.4` (1), `borderTopWidth: 1.5` and `borderLeftWidth: 1.5` to `border.1_5` (1 each), `borderWidth: 4` and `borderTopWidth: 4` to `border.4` (1 each), `minHeight: 44` and `minWidth: 44` to `size.touch` (1 each).
- no token: `minWidth: 0` (1); other literals not in the tool output: widths 12, 8 and 96, heights 6, 8 and 12.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): `text-xs` 3, `min-h-11` 1, `min-w-11` 1, `opacity-40` 1, `border` 11, `px-2` 2, `px-1` 1.

## Variants

none. `unstyled` is a boolean that removes the class strings; it is not a variant union.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | derived in code | idle activity renders no activity text (`activityAnnouncement` returns an empty string, so nothing is drawn). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | `disabled` prop. Step buttons get `disabled` and `accessibilityState={{disabled}}`; menus get `disabled`. |
| `blocked step button` | derived in code | a step button is also disabled when no zoom is given or when `stepZoom` returns the current value (end of presets). It adds `opacity-40`. |
| `hover` | class `hover:bg-surface-raised` | `hover:bg-surface-raised` on step buttons and on both menu triggers. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` on step buttons. |
| `saving` | derived in code | activity text "Saving". |
| `rendering` | derived in code | label text (default "Rendering"), a progressbar `View` (`accessibilityRole="progressbar"`, `aria-valuemin=0`, `aria-valuemax=100`, `aria-valuenow=percent`), a percent text when progress is given. Without progress the fill is 35% wide. |
| `recording` | derived in code | 8pt dot with `border-danger`, text "Recording", and an elapsed clock with `accessibilityLabel="Elapsed m:ss"`. |
| `error` | derived in code | `text-danger` text, `numberOfLines={2}`. |
| `pressed` | derived in code | no code (no `active:` class and no pressed style). |

- Text nodes for selection and activity set `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"`.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

none in source for StatusBar.tsx (no `Platform` use, no `.native`/`.web` siblings). package.json export conditions for the subpath: `types`, `react-native`, `default`, all resolving to `dist/components/shell/StatusBar.js`. The imported `MenuButton.tsx` returns focus to its trigger on close when `Platform.OS` is `qnx` or `marathon` (MenuButton.tsx line 73).

## A11y

- Contrast: text-text 16.01/15.31:1, text-text-muted 5.54/7.9:1, errors text-danger 5.91/8.01:1; progress fill border-accent 4.65/9.81:1; recording dot border-danger 5.91/8.01:1.
- Keyboard and focus: Zoom buttons `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:82). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Zoom buttons min-h-11 min-w-11 (:82), bar minHeight 44 (:91). Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: Selection, activity and zoom changes are polite live regions; progressbar with aria-valuemin/max/now (:103-105). The root View has label "Status" but no role (S3). The file's comment says recording clock and percent are not re-announced per tick.
- Motion: Indeterminate progress is a static 35% bar, no animation.
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Zoom menu uses MenuButton (F12).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility inside the zoom menu (F12). Test: See CommandPopover.

## Example

```tsx example=StatusBar
import {StatusBar} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/StatusBar";
export const Example = () => <StatusBar
  zoom={{value:100,onChange:()=>{},onFit:()=>{}}}
  units={{value:"px",options:[{value:"px",label:"Pixels"},{value:"mm",label:"Millimetres"}],onChange:()=>{}}}
  selection={{count:3,noun:{one:"layer",other:"layers"}}}
  activity={{kind:"rendering",progress:0.4,label:"Rendering"}}/>;
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `zoom` and `units` only when you need them; each renders its own control, and `onFit` adds a 'Fit to window' choice.
- Keep the `presets` list inside `zoom` unique, finite and positive; the default is 25, 50, 100, 200, 400.
- Drive `activity` with the `rendering` kind and a `progress` value to get a progressbar with `aria-valuenow`.

### Don't

- Do not pass over 1000 presets or duplicates in `zoom`, or over 256 `units` options, since both throw a `RangeError`.
- Do not pass your own `accessibilityLabel`; the component sets 'Status' after the spread and ignores yours.
- Do not assume screen reader output or the 44pt claim for the menu triggers; both are UNVERIFIED (`F12`).

# ToastAndProgress

## Purpose

List of toast notifications and progress jobs with dismiss and action buttons; shows three toasts until expanded, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/Button, @nyc-tron/feedback/ErrorMessage

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/ToastAndProgress
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { ToastAndProgress } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToastAndProgress";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { ToastAndProgress } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToastAndProgress";`

### Dependencies

- `../Button.tsx` (`@nyc-tron/ui/components/Button`), `../feedback/ErrorMessage.tsx`, `./useOwnedAction.ts`, `./progress-model.ts`, `../styles.ts`.
- External: `react`, `react-native` (`FlatList`, `ActivityIndicator`), `zustand` and `zustand/vanilla`. `zustand` is an optional peer in `package.json`.

## Props

Exports: `ToastAndProgress`, `ToastAndProgressProps`, and the re-exported types `ProgressJob`, `JobAction`, `ToastMessage`.

`ToastAndProgressProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. The rest spread goes to the root `View`; `style` is appended after `{gap:8}`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `string` | none | yes | Owner key for the pending-action hook (`useOwnedAction(scope)`). |
| `toasts` | `readonly ToastMessage[]` | none | yes | Only the first 3 show unless expanded. |
| `jobs` | `readonly ProgressJob[]` | none | yes | All jobs render. |
| `onDismissToast` | `(id: string) => void` | none | yes | Called by each toast's dismiss button. |
| `onToastAction` | `(toastId: string, actionId: string, signal: AbortSignal) => void \| Promise<void>` | none | no | Required at runtime when any toast has an `action`. |
| `onJobAction` | `(jobId: string, action: JobAction, signal: AbortSignal) => void \| Promise<void>` | none | no | Required at runtime when any job has actions. |
| `height` | `number` | `360` | no | Height of the list; must be finite and at least 44. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Removes class strings and passes `unstyled` to `Button` and `ErrorMessage`. |

`ToastMessage`: `id:string`, `title:string`, `detail?:string`, `tone:"info"|"success"|"error"`, `action?:{id:string;label:string}`.
`JobAction`: `"cancel"|"pause"|"resume"|"retry"`.
`ProgressJob`: `id`, `title`, `detail?`, `progress:number|null`, `actions:readonly JobAction[]`, and either `status:"queued"|"running"|"paused"|"cancelling"|"completed"|"cancelled"` or `status:"failed"` with a required `error:string`.

Throws: `TypeError("Notification actions require onToastAction")`, `TypeError("Job actions require onJobAction")`, `RangeError("Feedback height must be at least 44")`. `validateFeedback` throws for more than 100 toasts or 1000 jobs, duplicate or empty ids or titles, a progress outside 0..1, job actions not allowed for the status (queued: cancel; running: pause, cancel; paused: resume, cancel; failed: retry; cancelled: retry; cancelling and completed: none), a failed job with a blank error, and a completed job whose progress is not 1.

### Tokens

- Colour classes: `color.textMuted` 4, `color.text` 3, `color.border` 2, `color.surfaceSunken` 1, `color.primary` 1. Radius class: `radius.control` 1.
- Literals: `gap: 8` to `space.2` (5), `padding: 10` to `space.2.5` (2).
- no token: heights 6 and `"100%"`; the `height` default 360.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): `font-semibold` 3, `border` 6, `rounded-control` 1.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: pending, cancel and error timing of `useOwnedAction`; that hook was not read.
- UNVERIFIED: how `Button` and `ErrorMessage` render disabled and error states; they live in other files.
- UNVERIFIED: screen reader output for `role="alert"`/`role="status"` and the progressbar value props.

## Variants

- `ToastMessage.tone`: `"error"` gives the title `role="alert"`; `"info"` and `"success"` give `role="status"`. No colour or class changes by tone.
- `ProgressJob.status`: `"failed"` renders an `ErrorMessage` with the job error. `"queued"`, `"running"`, `"cancelling"` with `progress:null` render an `ActivityIndicator`; other statuses with `progress:null` render "Progress not reported".

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `empty` | derived in code | `ListEmptyComponent` text "No notifications or jobs". |
| `expanded` | derived in code | local store `{expanded}`; with more than 3 toasts a toggle button reads "Show all N notifications" or "Show recent notifications". |
| `pending (busy)` | derived in code | while `useOwnedAction` reports a pending action, toast action, dismiss and job action buttons get `disabled`, and a "Cancel pending notification or job request" button appears. |
| `error` | derived in code | `ErrorMessage` at the bottom shows `action.error` when set. |
| `progress` | derived in code | determinate bar width `progress*100%`; `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext` and `accessibilityValue` are set; indeterminate sets text "Progress not reported". |
| `Live regions` | derived in code | toast titles and job title lines set `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"`. |
| `hover, focus, pressed` | derived in code | no code in this file (inherited from `Button`). |

### Motion

`ActivityIndicator` for indeterminate queued, running or cancelling jobs (its animation is the native primitive's). No Animated or Reanimated calls. Progress never advances on a timer (doc comment).

### Platform notes

none in source. package.json export conditions: `types`, `react-native`, `default`, all to `dist/components/shell/ToastAndProgress.js`.

## A11y

- Contrast: text-text and text-text-muted 17.79/13.83:1 / 6.16/7.14:1; progress fill bg-primary 5.81/6.93:1. Default ActivityIndicator on a raised surface is 2.85/5.8:1 (iOS default colour) but the row text carries the same status.
- Keyboard and focus: Buttons only. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Height guard throws under 44 (:30); actions are Buttons. Android: see Button. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: Header role; toast rows role alert (errors) or status with a polite live region; job rows have progressbar with aria-valuemin/max/now/text and "Progress not reported" when unknown (:44-57).
- Motion: Spinner is an essential progress cue; no decorative animation.
- Review status: **PASS**. Status text, live regions and valued progressbar.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=ToastAndProgress
import {ToastAndProgress} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToastAndProgress";
export const Example = () => <ToastAndProgress scope="doc-1"
  toasts={[{id:"t1",title:"Export finished",tone:"success",action:{id:"open",label:"Open"}}]}
  jobs={[{id:"j1",title:"Render",status:"running",progress:0.5,actions:["pause","cancel"]}]}
  onDismissToast={()=>{}} onToastAction={async()=>{}} onJobAction={async()=>{}} height={240}/>;
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `onToastAction` whenever any toast has an `action`, and `onJobAction` whenever a job has actions; both are required at runtime.
- Set `tone` to `error` for failures so the title gets `role="alert"`; `info` and `success` use `role="status"`.
- Give a `failed` job an `error` string, which renders an `ErrorMessage`.

### Don't

- Do not set `height` below 44 or non-finite; it throws a `RangeError`.
- Do not send toast `id` values that are empty or duplicated, or progress outside 0..1; `validateFeedback` throws.
- Do not expect more than three toasts at once; only the first 3 show unless `expanded` is set from the toggle button.

# ToolRail

## Purpose

Toolbar rail of tool buttons, vertical on the left or right edge or a row at the bottom, with group flyouts, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/overlays/CommandPopover

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/ToolRail
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { ToolRail } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToolRail";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { ToolRail } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToolRail";`

### Dependencies

- `../overlays/CommandPopover.tsx`, `../overlays/popover-position.ts` (type), `./shell-keys.ts`, `./tool-rail-model.ts`, `../styles.ts`.
- External: `react`, `react-native` (`I18nManager`, `Platform`, `Pressable`, `useWindowDimensions`), `zustand`, `zustand/vanilla`. `zustand` is an optional peer.

## Props

Exports: `ToolRail`, `ToolRailProps`, `RailTool`, `RailToolVariant`, `ToolIcon`, `shownVariantId`, `toolIsActive`.

`ToolRailProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. Rest spread goes to the root `View`; `accessibilityRole="toolbar"`, `accessibilityLabel` and `aria-orientation` are set after the spread.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `string` | `"tools"` | no | In the boundary string; a change closes the flyout. |
| `revision` | `string \| number` | `0` | no | Same. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Disables every button and ignores selection. |
| `tools` | `readonly RailTool[]` | none | yes | Validated by `validateRailTools`. |
| `activeToolId` | `string \| undefined` | none | yes | Tool or variant id; the prop key is required but may be `undefined`. |
| `onSelectTool` | `(id: string) => void` | none | yes |  |
| `groupSelection` | `Readonly<Record<string, string>>` | none | no | Variant each group button shows; falls back to the first variant. |
| `label` | `string` | `"Tools"` | no | Toolbar accessible name. |
| `edge` | `"left" \| "right" \| "bottom"` | `"left"` | no |  |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Shows text labels beside icons. |
| `usableRegions` | `readonly Rect2D[]` | none | no | Falls back to a region of the window size. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`RailTool`: `id`, `label`, `icon:ToolIcon` (required), `shortcut?`, `disabled?`, `variants?:readonly RailToolVariant[]`.
`RailToolVariant`: `id`, `label`, `icon:ToolIcon` (required), `shortcut?`.
`ToolIcon`: `ReactNode | ((state:{active:boolean})=>ReactNode)`.

`shownVariantId(tool, groupSelection?)` returns the chosen variant id if it exists, else the first variant id, else the tool id. `toolIsActive(tool, activeToolId)` is true when the id equals the tool or any variant id. `validateRailTools` throws for more than 256 tools, more than 64 variants on a tool, empty, duplicate or over-long ids (256), labels over 512 characters, shortcuts over 256 characters, or a non-boolean `disabled`.

### Tokens

- Colour classes: `color.border` 3, `color.surfaceRaised` 1, `color.focus` 1, `color.primary` 1, `color.surfaceSunken` 1, `color.onPrimary` 1, `color.text` 1. Radius class: `radius.control` 1. The tool also matches `border-b-on-primary` and `border-b-text-muted` strings in code; the tool output does not list them separately.
- Literals: `borderLeftWidth: 5` and `borderBottomWidth: 5` map to a component-scoped `<Comp>.border.5` (1 each; not a global token).
- no token: icon box 28, corner offsets 3, flyout width 232, flyout offsets 4, 8 and 236.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): `gap-1` 1, `p-1` 1, `border` 12, `min-h-11` 1, `min-w-11` 1, `gap-2` 1, `rounded-control` 1, `border-2` 1, `px-2` 1, `opacity-40` 1, `text-sm` 1.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: flyout placement and dismissal; `CommandPopover` was not read.
- UNVERIFIED: roving-focus results of `rovingTarget` and the key shapes from `shellKey` (`shell-keys.ts` not read).
- UNVERIFIED: that long press and the `showVariants` screen-reader action open the flyout on a device; only the handlers are in source.
- UNVERIFIED: whether `measureInWindow` exists on every host's Pressable ref; the code skips the flyout when it is missing.

## Variants

- `edge`: `"left"` adds `border-r border-border`; `"right"` adds `border-l border-border`; `"bottom"` adds `border-t border-border` and lays tools in a wrapping row (otherwise a column). Left and right rails use the `vertical` roving axis, bottom uses `horizontal`. The flyout opens to the right of the tool for `left`, to the left for `right`, above for `bottom`.
- `expanded`: `true` adds `px-2` and a label `Text`; `false` adds `justify-center`.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `active` | derived in code | `toolIsActive`; sets `accessibilityState.selected`, `aria-pressed`, class `bg-primary forced-colors:border-2 forced-colors:border-[Highlight]`, label `text-on-primary`. |
| `resting` | derived in code | `bg-transparent hover:bg-surface-sunken`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | rail `disabled` or `tool.disabled`; `disabled` on the Pressable, `accessibilityState.disabled`; per-tool disabled adds `opacity-40`. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`; web keeps a roving `tabIndex` (0 on one stop, -1 elsewhere). |
| `group` | derived in code | a corner triangle drawn with borders, `aria-haspopup="menu"`, accessibilityHint "Long press for more tools.", actions `activate` and `showVariants`. |
| `flyout open` | derived in code | `CommandPopover` listing variants, with description "Current tool" and shortcut text. |
| `pressed` | derived in code | no code. |

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"`: adds `onKeyDown` and the roving `tabIndex` to each button.
- `I18nManager.isRTL` or the node direction flips the roving arrow direction; `edge` picks the arrow that opens the flyout (`ArrowRight` for left, `ArrowLeft` for right, `ArrowUp` for bottom).
- Flyout anchoring calls `measureInWindow` on the node when present.
- package.json export conditions: `types`, `react-native`, `default`, all to the same dist file. No `.native`/`.web` siblings.

## A11y

- Contrast: Active tool bg-primary with text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; others text-text 17.79/13.83:1. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).
- Keyboard and focus: Web: roving tabIndex and arrows (:81-125); `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:127). Flyout is CommandPopover. Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: min-h-11 min-w-11 (:126). Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: role=toolbar with orientation; tools role=button with label, hint (shortcut and long-press), state selected, aria-pressed, aria-haspopup, actions activate and showVariants (:97-116).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **UNVERIFIED**. Active fill and ring share one colour (F07); flyout is CommandPopover (F12).
  - UNVERIFIED: Focus visibility on the active tool (F07). Test: Tab to the active tool and compare screenshots.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=ToolRail
import {ToolRail} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/ToolRail";
import {Text} from "react-native";
export const Example = () => <ToolRail edge="left" activeToolId="move" onSelectTool={()=>{}}
  tools={[
    {id:"move",label:"Move",shortcut:"V",icon:<Text>M</Text>},
    {id:"brush",label:"Brush",icon:<Text>B</Text>,variants:[
      {id:"brush.soft",label:"Soft brush",icon:<Text>S</Text>,shortcut:"B"},
      {id:"brush.hard",label:"Hard brush",icon:({active})=><Text>{active?"H*":"H"}</Text>}]},
  ]}/>;
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `activeToolId` explicitly, even as `undefined`; the key is required.
- Choose `edge` to match placement, since `bottom` switches to a wrapping row and a horizontal roving axis.
- Provide `variants` on a tool to make a group; it gets `aria-haspopup="menu"` and a long-press hint.

### Don't

- Do not assume the active tool shows focus; its fill and `ring-focus` share one colour (F07), unverified.
- Do not rely on flyout placement or dismissal; both live in `CommandPopover` and are UNVERIFIED (F12).
- Do not pass over 256 `tools`, over 64 variants or duplicate ids; `validateRailTools` throws.

# UnitInput

## Purpose

Number field that parses and formats typed units from a UnitContext, with unit menu, min, max and arrow stepping, for React Native.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/shell/MenuButton

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/UnitInput
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { UnitInput } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/UnitInput";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { UnitInput } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/UnitInput";`

### Dependencies

- `./MenuButton.tsx`, `./shell-keys.ts`, `./unit-expression.ts`, `../styles.ts`.
- External: `react`, `react-native`, `zustand`, `zustand/vanilla` (optional peer).

## Props

Exports: `UnitInput`, `UnitInputProps`, and the re-exported types `UnitContext`, `UnitDimension`, `UnitName`.

`UnitInputProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. Rest spread goes to the root `View`; `style` is appended after `{opacity:disabled?0.5:1}`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | none | yes | Visible label and accessible name. |
| `scope` | `string` | none | no | A change abandons an uncommitted draft. |
| `value` | `number` | none | yes | Committed value in the dimension's base unit. |
| `onCommit` | `(value: number) => void` | none | yes | Called once per accepted entry or arrow step, with the clamped value. Not called when the clamped value equals `value`. |
| `context` | `UnitContext` | none | no | Without it the field is a plain number field that still accepts arithmetic. |
| `units` | `readonly UnitName[]` | none | no | Menu shows only with `context`, 2 or more units and `onUnitChange`. |
| `onUnitChange` | `(unit: UnitName) => void` | none | no |  |
| `min` | `number` | none | no | Base units. |
| `max` | `number` | none | no | Base units. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | no | Arrow step in display units; Shift x10, Alt /10. |
| `precision` | `number` | `2` | no | Decimals for a plain number field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`UnitContext` (shell/unit-expression.ts): `dimension:UnitDimension` (required), `unit:UnitName` (required), `pixelsPerInch?` (doc: default 96), `frameRate?` (required to use `f`), `sampleRate?` (required to use `smp`), `percentOf?` (required to use `%` for length).
`UnitDimension`: `"length"|"time"|"level"|"ratio"`. `UnitName` is one of length `px pt mm cm in %`, time `s ms f smp`, level `dB`, ratio `% x`.

### Tokens

- Colour classes: `color.text` 2, `color.danger` 2, `color.border` 2, `color.textMuted` 1, `color.surfaceSunken` 1, `color.focus` 1, `color.surfaceRaised` 1. Radius class: `radius.control` 1.
- Literals: `gap: 4` to `space.1` (1), `minHeight: 44` to `size.touch` (1), `opacity 0.5` to `opacity.0_5` (1).
- no token: `minWidth: 64` (1).
- Tailwind default classes (no token): `gap-1` 1, `text-xs` 2, `rounded-control` 1, `border` 8, `px-2` 2, `text-sm` 1.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: the accepted expression grammar and error strings; `parseUnitExpression` was not read beyond its signature use.
- UNVERIFIED: unit conversion factors (`unitScale`, `formatUnitValue`) in `unit-expression.ts`.
- UNVERIFIED: how `Escape`, Shift and Alt arrive on native keyboards; `shellKey` was not read.
- UNVERIFIED: the unit menu's behaviour; it lives in `MenuButton.tsx`.

## Variants

none. `context.dimension` selects the unit set, which is data, not a style variant.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | derived in code | shows `formatUnitValue(value, context)` or the plain number to `precision` decimals. |
| `editing` | derived in code | on focus; shows the draft text; border class `border-focus`. |
| `error` | derived in code | parse failure keeps editing and shows an `assertive` live-region message with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`; border `border-danger`. On blur with an unparsable draft the value is restored and the message reads "Not applied. ..." |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | `editable={false}`, `aria-disabled`, `accessibilityState.disabled`, wrapper opacity 0.5, and an open edit is discarded. |
| `hover and pressed` | derived in code | no code. |

- Escape restores the committed text; ArrowUp and ArrowDown step by `step` times the unit scale.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- `Platform.OS==="web"` adds `blurOnSubmit:false` to the `TextInput`.
- Escape handling and arrow stepping read keys through `shellKey` from `shell-keys.ts`.
- package.json export conditions: `types`, `react-native`, `default`, all to the same dist file. No `.native`/`.web` siblings.

## A11y

- Contrast: Field boundary 1.42/1.75:1 (F03); focus border-focus 5.22/7.67:1; error text-danger 5.91/8.01:1 and border-danger 6.57/7.24:1.
- Keyboard and focus: Native input; onFocus enters editing (:108). Windows, macOS, QNX: no Platform.OS branch in the file, focus visuals are the host's (GU1).
- Touch target: Input minHeight 44 (:127, size.touch). Android: 44 (F08). Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: accessibilityLabel, aria-invalid, aria-describedby for the error, error is an assertive live region, disabled state (:102-135).
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **FAIL**. Input boundary 1.42/1.75:1 (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=UnitInput
import {UnitInput} from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/UnitInput";
export const Example = () => <UnitInput label="Width" scope="layer-1.width" value={192}
  context={{dimension:"length",unit:"mm",pixelsPerInch:96}} units={["px","mm","in"]}
  onUnitChange={()=>{}} onCommit={()=>{}} min={0} max={4096} step={1}/>;
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass `context` to parse typed units, and set `frameRate`, `sampleRate` or `percentOf` when users type `f`, `smp` or `%`.
- Pass `units` with `onUnitChange` and a `context` to get the unit menu; it needs 2 or more units.
- Set `min` and `max` in base units, since `onCommit` receives the clamped value.

### Don't

- Do not rely on the field border as the only cue; `border-border` is 1.42/1.75:1 (F03) and the status is FAIL.
- Do not expect `onCommit` when the clamped value equals `value`; it is not called.
- Do not assume the expression grammar or conversion factors; `parseUnitExpression` and `unitScale` are UNVERIFIED.

# WorkspaceHost

## Purpose

Workspace shell with mode tabs, per-mode dock layouts and Ctrl or Cmd+1..9 shortcuts, for React Native; web shortcuts.

## Install

- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: @nyc-tron/core, react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/shell/AdaptiveDock

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/shell/WorkspaceHost
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { WorkspaceHost } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/WorkspaceHost";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { WorkspaceHost } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/shell/WorkspaceHost";`

### Dependencies

- `./AdaptiveDock.tsx`, `./dock-model.ts`, `./shell-keys.ts`, `./workspace-model.ts`, `../forge/announce.ts`, `../overlays/popover-position.ts` (type), `../styles.ts`, type `FoldFeature` from `@nyc-tron/core/folds`.
- External: `react`, `react-native` (`ScrollView`, `Pressable`, `Platform`), `zustand`, `zustand/vanilla`. `zustand` and `@nyc-tron/core` are optional peers.

## Props

Exports: `WorkspaceHost`, `WorkspaceHostProps`, `WorkspaceHostMode`, and the re-exported types `WorkspaceDocument`, `WorkspaceMode`, `DockLayout`, `DockPanel`.

`WorkspaceHostProps` extends `Omit<ViewProps,"children">`. `onLayout` is read (it also stores the measured width, then calls the caller's handler); `style` is appended after `{flex:1, direction}`; the rest spread goes to the root `View`.

Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document` | `WorkspaceDocument` | none | yes | Canvas is keyed by `document.id`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Blocks mode switches and layout changes. |
| `revision` | `string \| number` | `0` | no | Must be finite (number) or at most 512 characters (string). |
| `modes` | `readonly WorkspaceHostMode[]` | none | yes |  |
| `activeModeId` | `string` | none | yes | Throws `TypeError` if not one of `modes`. |
| `onModeChange` | `(modeId: string) => void` | none | yes |  |
| `panels` | `readonly DockPanel[]` | none | yes |  |
| `layouts` | `Readonly<Record<string, DockLayout>>` | none | yes | A mode without one uses its `defaultLayout`. |
| `onLayoutChange` | `(modeId: string, layout: DockLayout) => void` | none | yes |  |
| `canvas` | `ReactNode` | none | yes |  |
| `leading` | `ReactNode` | none | no | Before the title. |
| `trailing` | `ReactNode` | none | no | After the tabs. |
| `enableModeShortcuts` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Ctrl/Cmd+1..9 on web. |
| `applePlatform` | `boolean` | none (computed) | no | Computed by `appleByDefault()` when omitted. |
| `compactBelow` | `number` | `600` | no | Width under which tabs move to a second row. |
| `features` | `readonly FoldFeature[]` | none | no | Forwarded to `AdaptiveDock`. |
| `usableRegions` | `readonly Rect2D[]` | none | no | Forwarded. |
| `dockDefaults` | `Partial<DockDefaults>` | none | no | Forwarded as `defaults`. |
| `dockCompactBelow` | `number` | none | no | Forwarded as `compactBelow` when defined. |
| `isRTL` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Sets `direction:"rtl"` and the tab roving direction. |
| `className` | `string` | none | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

`WorkspaceDocument`: `id:string` (required), `title:string` (required), `dirty?:boolean`.
`WorkspaceMode`: `id`, `label`, `panels:readonly string[]`, `defaultLayout:DockLayout`, all required. `WorkspaceHostMode` adds `icon?:(state:{selected:boolean})=>ReactNode`.
`DockPanel` (shell/AdaptiveDock.tsx): `id`, `title`, `content:ReactNode`.
`DockLayout` (shell/dock-model.ts): `left?`, `right?`, `bottom?` (each a `DockStack` of `panels`, `active`, `size`), `floating:readonly FloatingPanel[]` (required; each `{id, rect}`), `compactSize?`.

Throws from `validateWorkspaceDocument` (id and title non-empty, id at most 256, title at most 512, `dirty` boolean) and `validateWorkspace` (mode and layout rules; the message list is in `workspace-model.ts` and was not enumerated here).

### Tokens

- Colour classes: `color.text` 2, `color.accent` 1, `color.border` 1, `color.surfaceRaised` 1, `color.focus` 1, `color.primary` 1, `color.surfaceSunken` 1, `color.onPrimary` 1. Radius class: `radius.control` 1.
- Literals: `gap: 8` to `space.2` (2), `paddingHorizontal: 8` to `space.2` (1), `paddingVertical: 4` to `space.1` (1), `gap: 4` to `space.1` (3), `gap: 2` to `space.0.5` (1), `borderRadius: 4` to `radius.4` (1), `borderWidth: 4` to `border.4` (1), `minHeight: 44` to `size.touch` (1).
- no token: `minWidth: 0` (2), the 8pt dot size.
- Tailwind default classes (no token): `border` 5, `text-base` 1, `font-semibold` 2, `min-h-0` 1, `min-w-0` 1, `min-h-11` 1, `min-w-11` 1, `gap-2` 1, `px-3` 1, `rounded-control` 1, `border-2` 1, `text-sm` 1.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: that the canvas keeps its state when modes switch; this depends on `AdaptiveDock` rendering, which was not read.
- UNVERIFIED: the exact `validateWorkspace` rules and `modeAnnouncement` text in `workspace-model.ts`.
- UNVERIFIED: the key fields `modeShortcutIndex` reads (`shellKey` and `code`) on each platform.
- UNVERIFIED: screen reader output of the tablist, the document header and the announcements.

## Variants

none as a union prop. `compactBelow` switches layout: when the measured width is above 0 and below it, the tab strip moves from beside the title to its own row.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `mode tabs` | derived in code | `selected` sets `accessibilityState.selected`, `aria-selected`, and class `bg-primary forced-colors:border-2 forced-colors:border-[Highlight]` with `text-on-primary font-semibold`; unselected `bg-transparent hover:bg-surface-sunken`, `text-text`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` prop | tabs get `disabled` and `accessibilityState.disabled`; `pick` does nothing. |
| `focus` | class `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus` | `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`; roving `tabIndex` (selected 0, others -1). |
| `dirty` | derived in code | an 8pt dot with `border-accent` before the title. |
| `narrow` | derived in code | width under `compactBelow`. |
| `mode announcement` | derived in code | on a mode change a polite live region (web) or `announce()` (native) speaks `modeAnnouncement`. |

- hover on tabs is the only pointer state; pressed has no code.

### Motion

none in source.

### Platform notes

- `appleByDefault()`: true on `ios` and `macos`; on `web` true when `navigator.platform` or `userAgent` matches `/Mac|iPhone|iPad/`. It picks the shortcut hint and `aria-keyshortcuts` prefix (`Meta+` or `Control+`).
- `Platform.OS==="web"`: title gets `aria-level:1`; a visually hidden polite live region renders; mode switches announce through it. On other platforms `announce()` from `../forge/announce.ts` is used instead.
- `enableModeShortcuts` keys work through a `View` `onKeyDown`; the doc comment states native hosts must route hardware keys themselves.
- Imported `announce.ts` branches on `qnx` and `marathon`.
- package.json export conditions: `types`, `react-native`, `default`. No `.native`/`.web` siblings.

## A11y

- Contrast: Selected mode tab bg-primary with text-on-primary 5.81/7.46:1; others text-text 17.79/13.83:1. Selected item is bg-primary and the ring is ring-focus, the same colour (1/1:1); the ring's outer edge still meets the page at 5.81/6.93:1 (F07).

- Touch target: Tabs min-h-11 min-w-11 (:216), bar minHeight 44 (:159). Android: 44 literal, 4dp under the 48dp Android guideline. Android 48dp: below (F08).
- Screen reader: tablist "Modes", tab with selected and disabled state, aria-keyshortcuts, hint; document title is a level 1 header on web; mode changes announced politely (web hidden live region, native announce) (:125-178, :206-215).
- Motion: None.

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Set `activeModeId` to an id present in `modes`; anything else throws a `TypeError`.
- Provide `layouts` per mode, or rely on each mode's `defaultLayout` when one is missing.
- Set `isRTL` for right-to-left UIs so `direction` and the tab roving direction flip.

### Don't

- Do not assume the selected tab shows focus; its `bg-primary` fill and `ring-focus` are one colour (F07), unverified.
- Do not pass a non-finite `revision`, or a string over 512 characters.
- Do not assume canvas state survives mode switches; that depends on `AdaptiveDock` and is UNVERIFIED.

- Peers: react, react-native, uniwind
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/theme/NightScope
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { NightScope } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/theme/NightScope";`

### Dependencies

- `uniwind`: `ScopedTheme`. Optional peer, `>=1.12.2 <2`.
- `react`: `ReactNode` (type).

## Props

Tier-1 reason: R2 core family (theme)
Import count: 0

`NightScopeProps` (own interface).

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | none | yes |  |
| `scheme` | `string` | "dark" | no | Uniwind theme name; cast with `as never` because `ThemeName` comes from the app's generated types. |

### Tokens

`node tokenuse.mjs` output: none. The file has no literals or token classes.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: what `ScopedTheme` renders and how it resolves variables on each platform; it lives in `uniwind`, which was not read, so the doc-comment description is unconfirmed.
- UNVERIFIED: whether the app's theme CSS scopes the class on web; that depends on the consumer.

## Variants

none. `scheme` is a free string.

## States

none. A pure wrapper around `ScopedTheme`.

### Motion

none in source

### Platform notes

Only the doc comment: on native, `ScopedTheme` resolves the theme variables for the subtree; on web it wraps the subtree in a `display: contents` element carrying the theme's class, which the app's theme CSS must scope (for example `.dark { --color-...: ... }`). The file has no `Platform.OS` check or sibling file.

## A11y

- Contrast: Wraps children in a ScopedTheme so tokens resolve at the dark values; the dark pairs in the contrast table apply.
- Keyboard and focus: Not interactive.
- Touch target: Not interactive.
- Screen reader: Adds no elements on native; a display: contents wrapper on web.
- Motion: None.
- Review status: **PASS**. Scope provider; dark pairs pass for text.
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

## Example

```tsx example=NightScope
import { Text } from "react-native";
import { NightScope } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/theme/NightScope";

export const Example = () => (
  <NightScope scheme="dark">
    <Text>Resolved with the dark theme variables.</Text>
  </NightScope>
);
```

## Do/Don't

### Do

- Pass a theme name your app defines as `scheme`; it defaults to `dark`.
- Wrap only the subtree that needs the scheme, passing it as `children`.
- Scope the theme class in your web CSS, since the `display: contents` wrapper depends on it.

### Don't

- Do not assume `ScopedTheme` resolves variables identically on every platform; that is UNVERIFIED.
- Do not expect `scheme` type checking; it is a free string cast with `as never`.
- Do not treat it as UI; it takes `children` and `scheme` only, has no states and adds no elements on native.

## Purpose

## Install

- Peers: @nyc-tron/core, react, react-native, zustand

npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/window/WindowTitleBar

- Import: `import { WindowTitleBar } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/window/WindowTitleBar";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:

## Props

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

`WindowChromeController` (core): `windowId`, `getSnapshot()`, `subscribe(listener)`, `run(command)`, `dispose()`. `WindowCommandResult` has `status` "done", "vetoed" (close only) or "ignored" with reason "busy", "unavailable" or "closed". `useWindowChrome(host: WindowChromeHost, windowId: string)` disposes the controller on unmount or host or window change.

### Tokens

`node tokenuse.mjs` output:
- `space.1.5` from `gap: 6` (x1), `space.2` from `paddingHorizontal: 8` (x1)
- `color.focus` (x1), `color.danger` (x1), `color.surfaceRaised` (x1), `color.textMuted` (x4), `color.surfaceSunken` (x1), `color.border` (x1), `color.accent` (x1), `color.text` (x1)
- `radius.control` (x2)
- `minWidth: 0`: no token

Tailwind default classes (no token): `opacity-80`, `opacity-50`, `rounded-control` (x2), `border` (x6), `rounded-full` (x2), `text-sm` (x2), `font-semibold`, `ring-2`. Unmapped: `TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT`, `CONTROL_TARGET`, `CAPTION_TARGET_WIDTH`, `GLYPH 12`, `STROKE 1.5`, `CHIP 20`, `DOT 8`.

### Unverified

- UNVERIFIED: the exact controls `describeTitleBar` returns per layout and snapshot state; only its call site and the core type definitions were read.
- UNVERIFIED: the on-screen insets a native host reports and how they combine with `insets.height`; they come from the host.

## Variants

- `controls.kind === "drawn"`, `layout: "macos"`: controls on the leading side, each in a 20-size bordered chip (`CHIP`) with a 44 by 44 target and `rounded-control`.
- `layout: "windows"`: controls trailing, 48 wide by 44 high, `hover:bg-danger` on close, else `hover:bg-surface-raised`.
- `kind: "native"`: no controls drawn; bar `paddingStart` and `paddingEnd` come from the insets and `minHeight` is `max(44, insets.height)`.
- Glyphs drawn from borders: close, minimize, restore, zoom (corner ticks inset 1, or 3 when `pressed`).

Which controls appear for a layout comes from core `describeTitleBar`.

## States

| State | How it is set | What the code does |
|---|---|---|
| `control enabled or disabled` | derived in code | `disabled`, `accessibilityState.disabled`, `opacity-50`. |
| `zoomed` | derived in code | `accessibilityState.selected` follows `control.pressed` when defined. |
| `focused window` | derived in code | title colour `text-text`, else `text-text-muted`. |
| `edited` | `edited` prop | dot (8 by 8, `border-accent`) and word. |
| `close vetoed` | derived in code | a polite live region, hidden visually, announces `closeBlockedLabel` until the next command. |
| `control hover, focus, pressed` | class `hover:*` | `hover:*`, `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-focus`, `active:opacity-80` (styled). |
| `pending commands` | derived in code | the controller reports `ignored` / `busy`; the title bar passes `snapshot.pending` into `describeTitleBar`. |

### Motion

none in source. `motion-reduce:transition-none` is on each control but nothing in the file sets a transition. `active:opacity-80` is the only press feedback.

### Platform notes

- Layout names `macos` and `windows` and the `native` insets (doc: AppKit window buttons, Windows caption buttons, iPadOS window controls) are data inputs, not `Platform.OS` checks. The file has none.
- The glyphs use borders so forced-colors mode keeps them (code comment).

## A11y

- Contrast: Title text-text or text-text-muted when unfocused 16.01/15.31:1 / 5.54/7.9:1. Control glyphs use border-text-muted; on the Windows close control hover:bg-danger turns the glyph into 1.07/1.01:1 (F05).
- Keyboard and focus: Controls `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-focus` (focus/surfaceRaised 5.81/6.93:1, focus/surfaceSunken 5.22/7.67:1) (:101). Windows and macOS layouts are chosen by the layout prop (:102-105). QNX: not branched.
- Touch target: CONTROL_TARGET 44, CAPTION_TARGET_WIDTH 48 (windows), TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT 44 (:13-17, size.touch). The window chrome is desktop-only, so the Android guideline does not apply.
- Screen reader: toolbar "{platform} window controls"; controls role=button with label and state disabled and selected; title role=header with edited suffix; blocked close is a polite live region (:96-129).
- Motion: `motion-reduce:transition-none` with no transition (F09).
- Review status: **FAIL**. Close glyph on hover has 1.07/1.01:1 contrast (1.4.11).
- Reviewed from source only. Nothing was rendered and no screen reader was run. See `docs/agent-native/05-accessibility-review.md`.

# DropModelModule

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/files/drop-model.ts -->
Platform-free rules shared by the web and native DropZone and FilePicker: `accept` strings in the HTML input syntax, MIME allowlists, and the enter/leave depth counter that keeps nested drag targets from flickering.
<!-- generated:end purpose -->

## Install

<!-- generated:begin install source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/package.json,packages/ui/src/components/files/drop-model.ts -->
- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native
- Requires: none

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/files/drop-model
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { acceptsFile, dragDepth, matchesAccept, matchesMime, parseAccept } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/files/drop-model";`

### Tarball install

<!-- generated:end install -->

# SpreadsheetGrid

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/SpreadsheetGrid.tsx -->
Three-pane sheet: frozen headers and frozen rows/columns sit outside the body scroll views and follow them through native-driver transforms, so a fling never shows the strips a frame behind.
<!-- generated:end purpose -->

## Install

<!-- generated:begin install source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/package.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/SpreadsheetGrid.tsx -->

- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/feedback/ErrorMessage, @nyc-tron/forge/spreadsheet/FormulaBar, @nyc-tron/gestures/PanResponderDrag

npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/forge/SpreadsheetGrid

- Import: `import { SpreadsheetGrid } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/forge/SpreadsheetGrid";`

# DynamicsTransferGraph

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/audio/DynamicsTransferGraph.tsx -->
Controlled compressor transfer graph: input level across, output level up, both -60..0 dBFS, with the 1:1 diagonal for reference, the engine's curve, a threshold marker and readouts.

| `onRatioCommit` | `(ratio: number) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | yes | Once per stepper press, with the next ratio stop (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20). |

| `onChange` | `(gain: number) => void` | not recorded | no | Called with each new gain while a drag is in progress, with the restored `value` when a drag is cancelled, and with the stepped gain just before each step's `onCommit`. Use it for live preview only. |
| `onCommit` | `(gain: number, signal?: AbortSignal) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | yes | Called once per completed drag on release, and once per step from the buttons, arrow keys or a screen-reader action. Not called when the gain is unchanged. The fader keeps showing `value`, so a rejected promise leaves the old level on screen; report the failure from the app. |
| `range` | `FaderRange` | `FADER_RANGES.UNITY (-60 dB to 0 dB)` | no | Decibel window of the travel. The bottom of travel is always silence. |
| `stepDb` | `number` | `1` | no | Size of one button or screen-reader step, in dB. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | no |  |
| `length` | `number` | `160` | no | Track length along the travel axis, in points. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no | Drop the default token recipe; supply a full app recipe via `className`. |

# LoudnessMeter

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter.tsx -->
Loudness readout for a rendered range: gated integrated loudness against a target, short-term and momentary maxima, sample peak with an overs warning, and the momentary history on a fixed -60..0 LUFS scale with the target line.
<!-- generated:end purpose -->

## Install

<!-- generated:begin install source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/package.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter.tsx -->
- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: react, react-native, zustand
- Requires: @nyc-tron/Button, @nyc-tron/feedback/ErrorMessage

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { LoudnessMeter } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { LoudnessMeter } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter";`
<!-- generated:end install -->

## Props

<!-- generated:begin props source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/audio/LoudnessMeter.tsx -->
Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">, ScopedControlProps`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | not recorded | yes | Name of the measured range, for example "Master, bars 1-17". Used as the group label. |
| `status` | `LoudnessStatus` | not recorded | yes | What to draw: a placeholder, the readings, an error or the silent message. |
| `rmsDbfs` | `number \| null` | not recorded | no | Gated integrated loudness, LUFS. `null` when silent or shorter than one block. |
| `onReset` | `(signal?: AbortSignal) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | no |  |
| `integratedLufs` | `number \| null` | not recorded | yes |  |
| `shortTermMaxLufs` | `number \| null` | not recorded | yes | Highest 3 s short-term loudness, LUFS. |
| `momentaryMaxLufs` | `number \| null` | not recorded | yes | Highest 400 ms momentary loudness, LUFS. |
| `samplePeakDbfs` | `number \| null` | not recorded | yes | Highest sample magnitude, dBFS. This is sample peak, not true peak. |
| `momentaryLufs` | `readonly (number \| null)[]` | not recorded | yes | Momentary loudness per 400 ms block, one block every `stepSeconds`. `null` blocks are silent. |
| `stepSeconds` | `number` | not recorded | yes | Seconds between momentary blocks (the engine reports 0.1). |
| `target` | `number` | `-14` | no | Integrated target in LUFS, drawn as a line on the history. |
| `onTargetChange` | `(lufs: number) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | no | Called when the person picks another target. Without it the target is shown as text and cannot be changed here. A rejected Promise leaves the `target` prop, and so the selection, unchanged. |
| `targets` | `readonly LoudnessTarget[]` | `LOUDNESS_TARGETS (-14, -16, -23 LUFS)` | no | Target choices. |
| `error` | `string` | not recorded | no | Shown when `status` is `"error"`: what failed, in the app's words. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | not recorded | no | Shown as a Retry button when `status` is `"error"`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no | Disables the target choice and Retry. |
| `historyHeight` | `number` | `112` | no | Height of the momentary history, in pt. |
| `className` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no |  |
<!-- generated:end props -->

# SmartGuidesModelModule

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/canvas/smart-guides-model.ts -->
Smart guide math for {@linkcode SmartGuides} (B-05): while a layer moves, find where its edges or centre line up with other layers' bounds, and where the gap to a neighbour equals a gap already on the canvas, then pull the move onto the nearest of those.

# HsvPicker

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/color/HsvPicker.tsx -->
Controlled HSV display-color picker: a saturation/value field, a native `@expo/ui` hue slider, 44pt saturation/brightness steppers and optional RGBA channels.
<!-- generated:end purpose -->

## Install

<!-- generated:begin install source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/package.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/color/HsvPicker.tsx -->
- Package: @nyc-tron/ui
- Peers: @expo/ui, expo-linear-gradient, react, react-native
- Requires: @nyc-tron/Button, @nyc-tron/forge/ColorChannels

### Registry install

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @nyc-tron/forge/color/HsvPicker
```

After a registry install, import from the installed path. `shadcn add` rewrites the `@/components` and `@/lib` prefixes to the aliases in the app's `components.json`.
- Import: `import { HsvPicker } from "@/components/nyc-tron/ui/components/forge/color/HsvPicker";`

### Tarball install

Install @nyc-tron/ui from the release tarball (README, "Installing from a release"), then import from the package:
- Import: `import { HsvPicker } from "@nyc-tron/ui/components/forge/color/HsvPicker";`
<!-- generated:end install -->

## Props

<!-- generated:begin props source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/color/HsvPicker.tsx -->
Extends: `Omit<ViewProps, "children">`

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `HsvColor` | not recorded | yes | The one authoritative color. Keep it in the host's store or engine. |
| `onValueChange` | `(next: HsvColor) => void` | not recorded | yes | Called on every preview change: field drag, slider, stepper or channel edit. |
| `onApply` | `(color: HsvColor) => void` | not recorded | no | Shows an Apply button. Commit one engine/undo transaction here; it is never called on drag release. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | not recorded | no | Shows a Cancel button. The host restores its own committed color. |
| `fieldHeight` | `number` | `210` | no | Saturation/value field height in dp, 80..1000. |
| `step` | `number` | `0.05` | no | Saturation and brightness change per stepper press or screen-reader action, 0.001..1. |
| `hueStep` | `number` | `5` | no | Hue change in degrees per screen-reader hue action, 1..180. |
| `showChannels` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Shows the RGBA {@linkcode ColorChannels} sliders under the HSV controls. |
| `showAlpha` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Shows the opacity slider inside the channel sliders. |
| `showHexReadout` | `boolean` | `true` | no | With `showChannels` off, shows the hex value under the hue slider. Turn it off when the host already shows the value, as `ColorPickerDialog` does. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no | Drops the default token recipe; the app supplies every class. |
<!-- generated:end props -->

<!-- generated:end variants -->

## Props

<!-- generated:begin props source=docs/api-signatures.json,packages/ui/src/components/forge/devices/DevicePairingDialog.tsx -->
| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `visible` | `boolean` | not recorded | yes |  |
| `state` | `PairingState` | not recorded | yes | Pairing phase, mapped by the app from its own transport controller. |
| `onScan` | `() => void` | not recorded | yes | Start (or restart) discovery. |
| `onSelect` | `(deviceId: string) => void` | not recorded | yes | The user picked a device. Rows are tappable while a scan is still running, so stop discovery before connecting. |
| `onStopSearch` | `() => void` | not recorded | no | Stop the running search or connection attempt. The dialog stays open; move the state back to `idle`, `found` or `error`. Called by "Stop searching" and by "Cancel" while connecting. Falls back to `onCancel`; with neither, those buttons are disabled. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | not recorded | no | Close the dialog. Called by the close button and the system back gesture in every state except `connected`, which calls `onDone`. While `awaiting-input` the device is linked: treat this as closing the window, not disconnecting. Falls back to `onCancel` for unlinked states and to `onDone` for linked ones. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | not recorded | no |  |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | not recorded | yes | Retry after an error. |
| `onDone` | `() => void` | not recorded | yes | Close after a successful connection. Closing a connected dialog is not a disconnect, so it never calls `onCancel`. |
| `onOpenSettings` | `() => void` | not recorded | no | Open system settings for permission or radio errors and `system-pairing`. |
| `intro` | `string` | not recorded | no | Shown above the guidance while `idle`, before the user starts a search. Say what the button will do, e.g. that the app will ask for Bluetooth access, or that this platform pairs in system Settings. |
| `title` | `string` | `"Connect a device"` | no |  |
| `deviceNoun` | `string` | `"device"` | no | Lowercase noun used in copy, e.g. "pen" or "controller". |
| `renderStatusArt` | `(phase: PairingArtPhase, state: PairingState) => ReactNode` | not recorded | no | Status illustration, e.g. a Rive state machine. Show `connected` only for a verified link: the app decides what verified means. |
| `className` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no |  |
| `testID` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |

| `scrollX` | `number` | not recorded | no | Follow another view's horizontal scroll (the roll's `onScrollX`). When omitted the lane scrolls on its own. |
| `step` | `number` | `4` | no | Arrow-key and screen-reader step. |
| `selectedIndex` | `number` | not recorded | no |  |
| `onSelect` | `(index: number) => void` | not recorded | no |  |
| `onVelocityCommit` | `(index: number, velocity: number) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | yes | Once per finished bar drag or step. |
| `onVelocitiesCommit` | `(changes: readonly VelocityChange[]) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | not recorded | no | Batch edit: once per finished line drawing or ramp, with the changes sorted by note index, no duplicate index, never empty. Maps onto the Cadence `setVelocities` op, so one gesture is one undo step. Giving it shows the Bars / Line tool row; leaving it out keeps the lane bar-only. A rejected promise leaves the committed velocities as they are. |
| `tool` | `VelocityTool` | not recorded | no | Current tool. Leave out to let the lane keep its own (starting at `"bars"`). |
| `onToolChange` | `(tool: VelocityTool) => void` | not recorded | no | Called when the person picks the other tool. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |
| `label` | `string` | `"Velocity"` | no |  |
| `className` | `string` | not recorded | no |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | not recorded | no |  |

# RollSlipSlideControls

## Purpose

<!-- generated:begin purpose source=packages/ui/src/components/forge/timeline/RollSlipSlideControls.tsx -->
Trim tools (D-21): a picker for select, slip, slide, roll and ripple, which sets `tool` on `TimelineClipLane` for drag editing, and nudge buttons (one and ten frames each way) that apply the chosen tool to the selected clip, which is the keyboard and screen-reader path.
<!-- generated:end purpose -->
